definition_zh: 机器人；自动机械装置；受程序控制替人作业的机器；机械般行事的人
definition_en: a machine that carries out complex actions automatically, especially one controlled by a computer
core_image: 一只没有面孔的铁手臂从装配线上抬起，照着同一道弧线重复了十万次
scene: 车间里一排焊枪反复走同一条轨迹，工人只在外围看着仪表。The robot welds the same seam on every chassis without tiring.
sceneCN: 这里指按程序自动完成重复动作的机器（第 1 个义项：能自动执行复杂动作的机器）；句意为这台机器给每个底盘焊同一条接缝，从不会累。图中可辨识物件：焊枪、底盘、控制柜、护栏。

pos.zh: 机器人；自动机械；机械般的人

derivatives.zh: 机械地；像机器人一样地
使自动化；使像机器一样运转

senses.title: A machine that works on its own
senses.definition: a machine built to carry out complex actions automatically, especially under computer control
senses.definitionCN: 一种被造来完成复杂动作的机器，尤指由计算机控制
senses.example: The robot sorts parcels faster than the night shift.
senses.exampleCN: 这台机器分拣包裹比夜班还快。
senses.why: The Czech word behind it meant forced labour, so the first thing named was a worker that never rests.
senses.whyCN: 它背后的捷克词意为强制劳役，因此最早被命名的是一个从不休息的劳动者。

senses.title: The arm on a production line
senses.definition: an articulated mechanical arm that repeats a set of movements on a production line
senses.definitionCN: 一种在流水线上重复一套动作的关节式机械臂
senses.example: One robot sprays paint inside the cab.
senses.exampleCN: 一台机械臂在驾驶室内部喷漆。
senses.why: The first factory machines replaced a single pair of hands at one station, and the arm is that hand writ large.
senses.whyCN: 最早的工厂机器在工位上替代一双手，机械臂就是把那双手放大。

senses.title: A machine with a human shape
senses.definition: a machine built with a head, arms and legs in imitation of the human body
senses.definitionCN: 仿照人体造出头部、手臂与双腿的机器
senses.example: The humanoid robot shook hands with the visitors.
senses.exampleCN: 那台人形机器人与参观者握了手。
senses.why: Stories gave the word a body before engineers did, and the human shape became a category of its own.
senses.whyCN: 故事在工程师之前就给了这个词一具身体，人形于是自成一类。

senses.title: A self-moving household device
senses.titleCN: 会自己走动的家用设备
senses.definition: a domestic machine that moves and acts without a driver, such as a vacuum cleaner
senses.definitionCN: 一种无需人驾驶就能移动并作业的家用机器，如吸尘器
senses.example: The robot cleans under the sofa every morning.
senses.exampleCN: 这台机器每天早上清理沙发底下。
senses.why: Cheap sensors carried the word out of the factory and into the home, where the work is small but repeated daily.
senses.whyCN: 廉价传感器把这个词从工厂带进家庭，那里的活虽小，却天天重复。

senses.title: A person who acts mechanically
senses.definition: a person who repeats actions or obeys orders without thought or feeling
senses.definitionCN: 不加思考与感情地重复动作或服从命令的人
senses.example: He turned into a robot at the front desk, repeating the same line all day.
senses.exampleCN: 他在前台变成了机器，整天重复同一句话。
senses.why: The metaphor borrows the machine's lack of an inner life, not its metal.
senses.whyCN: 这个比喻借的是机器没有内心生活，而不是它的金属。

senses.title: A software agent
senses.titleCN: 在网络上自动干活的程序
senses.definition: a program that performs tasks on a network by itself, such as crawling or trading
senses.definitionCN: 一种在网络上自行执行任务的程序，如抓取网页或自动交易
senses.example: A robot crawls the site every hour for new prices.
senses.exampleCN: 一个程序每小时爬取该网站以获取新价格。
senses.why: When the work moved into software, the name of the worker moved with it.
senses.whyCN: 当活计搬进软件，劳动者的名字也跟着搬了过去。

senses.title: A machine guided in surgery
senses.titleCN: 手术中被引导的精密机器
senses.definition: a machine that a surgeon guides to perform very precise operations
senses.definitionCN: 由外科医生引导、用于极精细操作的手术机器
senses.example: The robot removed the tissue with millimetre accuracy.
senses.exampleCN: 那台机器以毫米级精度切除了组织。
senses.why: Steadiness and precision are the machine's defining virtues, and surgery is where they matter most.
senses.whyCN: 稳定与精确是这种机器的看家本事，而手术正是最需要它们的地方。

senses.title: An artificial being in fiction
senses.titleCN: 虚构作品中的人造生命
senses.definition: an artificial being in stories that may think, speak or feel
senses.definitionCN: 故事中可能思考、说话或有情感的人造生命
senses.example: The robot in the film asks whether it can dream.
senses.exampleCN: 影片中的机器人问自己是否会做梦。
senses.why: The play that coined the word put artificial workers on a stage, and fiction has kept that body ever since.
senses.whyCN: 造出这个词的戏剧把人工劳动者搬上舞台，虚构作品从此保留了那具身体。

senses.title: A person controlled by another
senses.definition: someone who merely carries out another person's will
senses.definitionCN: 只替别人执行意志的人
senses.example: The clerk was a robot for the director's decisions.
senses.exampleCN: 那名职员成了主管决定的传声筒。
senses.why: The oldest layer is forced labour, so the puppet sense still carries a trace of coercion.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的一层是强制劳役，因此这层傀儡义仍带着胁迫的影子。

intro.en: Robot comes from Czech robota 'forced labour', the word Karel Capek used for artificial workers in his 1920 play. The exact step from robota to robot is source uncertain, and the Slavic family around it is generally accepted.
intro.cn: robot 来自捷克语 robota「强制劳役」，恰佩克在一九二〇年的戏剧里用它称呼人造劳动者。从 robota 到 robot 的确切一步来源不确定；它周围的斯拉夫词族关系则一般认为成立。

items.en: Czech robota meant forced labour or drudgery, the unpaid work owed to a landlord, and the related rob meant slave.
items.cn: 捷克语 robota 指强制劳役、苦工，即欠地主的无偿劳动；相关的 rob 指奴隶。

items.en: Karel Capek's play R.U.R. put artificial workers on stage and gave them a name built on that labour word; the play reached English in 1923.
items.cn: 恰佩克的戏剧《罗素姆万能机器人》把人工劳动者搬上舞台，并用那个表示劳役的词为他们命名；该剧一九二三年译入英语。

items.en: Karel said his brother Josef suggested the shorter form, a detail that is well recorded but leaves the final shaping of the word source uncertain.
items.cn: 恰佩克说较短的词形由哥哥约瑟夫提出；这一细节记录充分，但词形的最终定形来源不确定。

items.en: Russian rabota 'work' and rob 'slave' belong to the same Slavic group; whether English took the word from robota or from rob is source uncertain.
items.cn: 俄语 rabota「工作」与 rob「奴隶」属同一斯拉夫语组；英语究竟取自 robota 还是 rob，来源不确定。

items.en: The word moved from the stage to the factory in the 1960s, when programmable arms began welding and painting on car lines.
items.cn: 二十世纪六十年代，这个词从舞台走进工厂，可编程机械臂开始在汽车生产线上焊接与喷漆。

items.en: In the 1990s the same name was given to programs that act on their own across networks, and the clipping bot became a word in its own right.
items.cn: 二十世纪九十年代，同样的名字被给了在网络上自行行动的程序，截短形式 bot 也独立成词。

note.en: The first group looks or sounds like robot; the second group names neighbouring ideas in the same field.
note.cn: 第一组在形音上与「robot」相近；第二组是同一领域里意思相邻的其他说法。

entries.definition: The adjective for anything done by a robot or done in a stiff, unfeeling way.
entries.definitionCN: 指由机器完成的，或指僵硬无情的。

entries.definition: The subject and industry of building robots; the ending makes it a field of study.
entries.definitionCN: 研究与应用机器人的学科，词尾使其成为一门领域。

entries.definition: The adverb for acting with machine-like regularity.
entries.definitionCN: 指以机器般规律的方式行事。

entries.definition: A short form for a software agent, cut from the same word.
entries.definitionCN: 软件代理程序的简称，由同一个词截短而来。

entries.definition: To steal; it merely looks close and has no connection with the machine word.
entries.definitionCN: 意为偷窃；只是形近，与机器这个词没有关联。

entries.definition: A self-moving machine, especially one that imitates a living body.
entries.definitionCN: 能自行活动的机器，尤指模仿活物的装置。

entries.definition: A machine built to look like a human being.
entries.definitionCN: 造得外表像人的机器。

entries.definition: An unmanned vehicle or aircraft that operates by remote control or programming.
entries.definitionCN: 按遥控或程序运行的无人载具或飞行器。

entries.definition: A program that automates a repetitive online task.
entries.definitionCN: 把重复的网络任务自动化的程序。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real Czech source, the real family and real fixed phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用真实的捷克语来源、真实同族词与真实固定搭配。

normal.en: Czech robota meant forced labour, and the robot is a worker that never asks for rest.
normal.cn: 捷克语 robota 意为强制劳役，而机器人就是一个从不要求休息的劳动者。

normal.en: Karel Capek's 1920 play gave the word to the world, and Josef Capek is credited with the shorter form.
normal.cn: 恰佩克一九二〇年的戏剧把这个词给了世界，较短的词形则归功于约瑟夫。

normal.en: The family runs robot, robotic, robotics, robotically and robotize.
normal.cn: 同族词有 robot、robotic、robotics、robotically 与 robotize。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the uses: industrial robot, robot arm, surgical robot, robot vacuum.
normal.cn: 固定说法标出用法：工业机器人、机械臂、手术机器人、扫地机器人。

normal.en: Bot is the clipped form that now names software agents.
normal.cn: bot 是截短形式，如今用来指软件代理程序。

abstract.en: A robot is a pair of hands that never sleeps and never complains.
abstract.cn: 机器人是一双不睡觉也不抱怨的手。

abstract.en: Its steadiness is the point: the same arc, ten thousand times, without drift.
abstract.cn: 它的要点在稳定：同一条弧线走一万次也不走样。

abstract.en: The old forced-labour word still echoes whenever a person is called a robot.
abstract.cn: 每当一个人被叫作机器，那个古老的劳役词就还在回响。

examples.en: The warehouse robot lifts pallets that would strain two workers.
examples.cn: 仓库机器人搬起会让两名工人吃力的托盘。

examples.en: A small robot now inspects the pipes too narrow for a person.
examples.cn: 一台小机器现在负责检查人钻不进去的管道。

examples.en: The surgeon guided the robot through a cut only a few centimetres wide.
examples.cn: 外科医生引导机器穿过仅几厘米宽的切口。

dict_mnemonic.text: 读作「肉包特」——铁皮包的伙计不吃不睡，只照程序干活：机器人

root: 捷克语 robota「强制劳役」← rob「奴隶」；与俄语 rabota「工作」同属斯拉夫词族，英语取词的确切路径来源不确定。恰佩克一九二〇年的戏剧《罗素姆万能机器人》使该词通行，短形由约瑟夫·恰佩克提议；截短形式 bot 后指软件代理。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses follow one worker: a self-moving machine, the factory arm, a human-shaped body, a domestic device, a mechanical person, a software agent, a surgical tool, a fictional being, and finally a puppet.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项跟着同一个劳动者：自行作业的机器、工厂机械臂、人形身体、家用设备、机械般的人、软件代理、手术工具、虚构生命，最后是受人摆布的傀儡。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an iron arm repeats one arc ten thousand times without rest.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只铁手臂重复同一道弧线一万次，从不休息。

branches.en: THE MACHINE ITSELF: a programmable worker that acts without a hand on it.
branches.cn: 机器本身：一个无需人手在旁就能作业的可编程劳动者。

branches.en: THE PRECISE ARM: the same arm repeats a seam on a line or holds a tool inside an operation.
branches.cn: 精确的手臂：同一只臂在流水线上重复焊缝，或在手术中稳住器械。

branches.en: THE BODY: a human shape built for research, display or a story.
branches.cn: 身体：为人形研究、展示或故事而造出的躯体。

branches.en: THE HOUSEHOLD DEVICE: the worker shrinks to a disc that cleans under the sofa.
branches.cn: 家用设备：劳动者缩成一块在沙发底下清扫的圆盘。

branches.en: THE MECHANICAL PERSON AND THE PROGRAM: a person without inner life, a program without a body, a will without its own.
branches.cn: 机械的人与程序：没有内心的人、没有身体的程序、没有自主的意志。

intro.en: Robot is built on a Czech labour word and an English clipping; it has no Latin root, so the Latin list is left empty.
intro.cn: robot 由一个捷克语劳役词与英语截短形式构成，没有拉丁词根，故拉丁词条留空。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin ancestor for this word; the relevant source is Czech robota and its Slavic family.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁语祖先；相关来源是捷克语 robota 及其斯拉夫词族。

items.example: The play gave the machine its name.
items.exampleCN: 戏剧给了这种机器名字。

items.example: The name began as a word for unpaid work.
items.exampleCN: 这个名字最初指无偿劳动。

items.example: The root marks the worker as unfree.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根标明劳动者的不自由。

items.example: The suffix turns the machine into a discipline.
items.exampleCN: 后缀把机器变成一门学科。

items.example: The adjective describes the manner as well as the machine.
items.exampleCN: 形容词既描述机器，也描述那种做派。

items.example: The adverb marks behaviour without feeling.
items.exampleCN: 副词标出没有感情的举止。

items.example: The verb names the change, not the thing.
items.exampleCN: 动词指变化过程，而非事物本身。

items.example: The short form now lives on the network.
items.exampleCN: 截短形式如今生活在网络里。

items.meaning: suffix for a field of study
items.example: It builds robotics, economics and physics.
items.exampleCN: 它构成机器人学、经济学与物理学等词。

definition_zh: 建模；模型制作；用数学或计算机方法对现实对象作简化模拟；模特职业
definition_en: the activity of making a model, especially a simplified mathematical or computer representation of a real system
core_image: 一张纸上先画出桥的骨架，再把每根杆编号成可以计算的线段
scene: 工程师在屏幕上把一座桥的受力情况搭成可计算的骨架，反复改参数看结果。Careful modeling showed where the bridge would sag.
sceneCN: 这里指用数学或计算机方式对现实对象作模拟（第 2 个义项：数学建模）；句意为细致的建模显示出桥会在哪里下弯。图中可辨识物件：屏幕、曲线、桥的骨架、参数表。

pos.zh: 建模；模型制作；模拟；模特工作

derivatives.zh: 模型；模特；模范；制作模型

senses.title: Making a physical model
senses.definition: the activity of building a small object that represents a larger thing
senses.definitionCN: 制作一个小物件以代表更大实物的活动
senses.example: The modeling of the wing took three weeks in the workshop.
senses.exampleCN: 机翼模型的制作在车间花了三周。
senses.why: The oldest sense is a hand making a reduced copy, and every later sense keeps that idea of a stand-in.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的意思是用手做出缩小的复制件，后来每一层意思都保留了这个替身的念头。

senses.title: Mathematical modeling
senses.definition: the activity of describing a real system with equations so that its behaviour can be calculated
senses.definitionCN: 用方程描述真实系统、使其行为可以被计算的活动
senses.example: Mathematical modeling predicted the flood level within ten centimetres.
senses.exampleCN: 数学建模把洪水水位的预测误差控制在十厘米内。
senses.why: The copy stops being an object and becomes a set of relations, but it still stands in for the real thing.
senses.whyCN: 复制件不再是一件实物，而变成一组关系，但它仍然替真实之物站台。

senses.title: Computer simulation
senses.definition: the building of a computational representation of a system and the running of it under changing conditions
senses.definitionCN: 为系统建立计算表示，并在变化条件下运行它
senses.example: Climate modeling needs enormous computing power.
senses.exampleCN: 气候模拟需要极大的算力。
senses.why: Once the equations could be run on a machine, modeling became an experiment performed inside a computer.
senses.whyCN: 当方程可以在机器上运行，建模就变成了在计算机内部做的实验。

senses.title: Three-dimensional modeling
senses.definition: the construction of a digital three-dimensional shape that can be rotated, lit and rendered
senses.definitionCN: 构建可旋转、打光并渲染的数字三维形体
senses.example: The studio teaches 3D modeling for game assets.
senses.exampleCN: 工作室教授用于游戏资产的三维建模。
senses.why: A screen gives the old clay copy a new material: surface without weight.
senses.whyCN: 屏幕给了旧日的黏土复制件一种新材质：没有重量的表面。

senses.title: Financial modeling
senses.definition: the building of a spreadsheet or calculation that projects a company's income, costs and value
senses.definitionCN: 用表格或计算来推演企业收入、成本与价值的活动
senses.example: Her financial modeling convinced the board to delay the purchase.
senses.exampleCN: 她的财务建模说服董事会推迟采购。
senses.why: The same habit of building a stand-in is applied to money, where the model predicts rather than depicts.
senses.whyCN: 同一套造替身的习惯被用到钱上，此时模型是预测而非描摹。

senses.title: Fashion modeling
senses.definition: the profession of posing for photographs or walking in shows to display clothes
senses.definitionCN: 为拍照摆姿势或走秀展示服装的职业
senses.example: Fashion modeling took him to four cities in one month.
senses.exampleCN: 模特工作让他一个月跑了四座城市。
senses.why: Here the living body itself is the copy, standing in for the garment's ideal wearer.
senses.whyCN: 这里活人的身体本身就是复制件，替服装理想的穿着者站台。

senses.title: Behaviour modeling
senses.definition: the learning of behaviour by watching and copying another person
senses.definitionCN: 通过观察与模仿他人来学习行为
senses.example: Behaviour modeling helps new staff learn the safety routine.
senses.exampleCN: 行为示范帮助新员工学会安全流程。
senses.why: The pattern to be copied is no longer an object but a way of acting, which is the furthest reach of the word.
senses.whyCN: 被复制的对象不再是物件，而是一种行事方式，这是这个词走得最远的一步。

senses.title: Clay and sculpture modeling
senses.definition: the shaping of soft material by hand into a three-dimensional form
senses.definitionCN: 用手把柔软材料塑成立体形状
senses.example: Clay modeling is the first class in the sculpture course.
senses.exampleCN: 黏土塑造是雕塑课的第一堂课。
senses.why: This is the workshop sense at its plainest: fingers pressing a material until it holds the intended shape.
senses.whyCN: 这是最朴素的工坊义：手指按压材料，直到它呈现想要的形状。

intro.en: Modeling is model plus -ing. Model came into English from French modelle, from Italian modello, from a reconstructed Vulgar Latin diminutive of modulus 'small measure'. The British spelling doubles the l.
intro.cn: modeling 是 model 加 -ing。model 经法语 modelle、意大利语 modello，上溯到俗拉丁语中 modulus「小量度」的一个重构指小形式；英式拼写双写 l。

items.en: Latin modus meant a measure, a manner or a limit, the base of modulus and of the English words mode and moderate.
items.cn: 拉丁 modus 指量度、方式或限度，是 modulus 以及英语 mode、moderate 的基础。

items.en: Modulus was a small measure or a standard unit, used for a model, a mould or a rhythmic unit.
items.cn: modulus 指小量度或标准单位，用于模型、模具或节律单位。

items.en: A Vulgar Latin diminutive of modulus is reconstructed as the source of the Italian and French forms; the exact shape is a reconstructed form, not an attested word.
items.cn: 俗拉丁语中 modulus 的一个指小形式被重构为意大利语与法语词形的来源；其确切形态是重构形式，并非有记录的词。

items.en: Italian modello and French modelle both meant a small copy or a pattern, and French carried the word into English in the sixteenth century.
items.cn: 意大利语 modello 与法语 modelle 都指小复制件或样板，法语在十六世纪把这个词带进英语。

items.en: English model first named an architect's pattern or a small copy, then widened to a person worth imitating and to a version of a product.
items.cn: 英语 model 最初指建筑师的样板或小复制件，后来扩展到值得模仿的人以及产品的型号。

items.en: The ending -ing turns the verb into the name of the activity, so modeling is the work of making or using a model; British spelling keeps the doubled l before the ending.
items.cn: 词尾 -ing 把动词变成活动名称，因此 modeling 指制作或使用模型的工作；英式拼写在词尾前保留双写的 l。

note.en: The first group looks or sounds like modeling; the second group names neighbouring ideas in the same field.
note.cn: 第一组在形音上与「modeling」相近；第二组是同一领域里意思相邻的其他说法。

entries.definition: The base noun and verb behind the activity; it names the thing or the act, not the ongoing work.
entries.definitionCN: 这项活动背后的名词与动词，指事物或动作，而不是持续的工作。

entries.definition: The same word written with a doubled l, standard in British English.
entries.definitionCN: 同一个词的英式拼写，双写 l。

entries.definition: A person who builds models, spelled with a doubled l in British usage.
entries.definitionCN: 建造模型的人，英式拼写双写 l。

entries.definition: Relating to mode or manner, especially in grammar or music; it shares modus but not the copy.
entries.definitionCN: 与方式或调式有关，尤用于语法或音乐；它共享 modus，但没有复制件之义。

entries.definition: A measured unit or separable part, from the same small-measure root.
entries.definitionCN: 量度单位或可拆分部件，同出那个「小量度」词根。

entries.definition: The running of an imitation of a system, often to see how it behaves.
entries.definitionCN: 运行系统的仿制品，常用来看它会如何表现。

entries.definition: Any stand-in for something else, whether a picture, a symbol or a set of equations.
entries.definitionCN: 任何替代他物的东西，无论是图像、符号还是一组方程。

entries.definition: Imitation that aims to match the original's behaviour closely, often in computing.
entries.definitionCN: 力求贴近原物行为的模仿，常用于计算领域。

entries.definition: Building a first working version to test an idea.
entries.definitionCN: 造出第一个可工作的版本以检验构想。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real Latin measure word, the real spelling variants and real technical phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用真实的拉丁「量度」词、真实拼写变体与真实技术搭配。

normal.en: The root modus is Latin for measure, so a model is something measured out as a stand-in.
normal.cn: 词根 modus 是拉丁语「量度」，因此模型就是量出来充当替身的东西。

normal.en: The family runs model, modeling, modeler, modeled and remodel.
normal.cn: 同族词有 model、modeling、modeler、modeled 与 remodel。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the fields: mathematical modeling, climate modeling, 3D modeling, financial modeling.
normal.cn: 固定说法标出领域：数学建模、气候建模、三维建模、财务建模。

normal.en: British English writes modelling with a doubled l, American English writes modeling.
normal.cn: 英式英语写作 modelling，双写 l；美式英语写作 modeling。

normal.en: The suffix -ing names the activity rather than the object.
normal.cn: 后缀 -ing 命名的是活动，而不是物件。

abstract.en: The model is a stand-in small enough to turn in the hand.
abstract.cn: 模型是一个小到能在手里转动的替身。

abstract.en: The equations are the same stand-in, only now made of relations instead of wood.
abstract.cn: 方程是同一个替身，只是材质从木头换成了关系。

abstract.en: A model that predicts is a copy that looks forward.
abstract.cn: 会预测的模型，是一个朝前看的复制件。

examples.en: Mathematical modeling shortened the design cycle by half.
examples.cn: 数学建模把设计周期缩短了一半。

examples.en: The team used modeling to test the layout before building it.
examples.cn: 团队用建模在动工前检验布局。

examples.en: She teaches modeling at a school for game artists.
examples.cn: 她在一所游戏美术学校教建模。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「模特 + 灵」——模特摆姿势是造替身，建模也是造替身，两件事同一个词

root: 拉丁 modus「量度」→ modulus「小量度、标准单位」→ 俗拉丁语指小形式（重构形式）→ 意大利 modello／法语 modelle「小复制件、样板」→ 英语 model；加 -ing 表示这项活动，英式拼写双写 l。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one stand-in: a reduced object, a set of equations, a computer experiment, a digital surface, a financial projection, a posing body, a copied behaviour, and clay under the fingers.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项跟着同一个替身：缩小的实物、一组方程、一次计算机实验、一张数字表面、一份财务推演、一具摆姿势的身体、一种被模仿的行为，以及指间的黏土。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a bridge drawn as numbered rods on paper, small enough to calculate and real enough to predict.
core.cn: 核心意象：一座桥被画成纸上编号的杆件，小到可以计算，又真实到可以预测。

branches.en: THE PHYSICAL COPY: a hand builds a reduced object so that the real one can be discussed.
branches.cn: 实物复制件：手做出缩小件，好让人能讨论真正的那个。

branches.en: THE EQUATIONS: the copy becomes a set of relations that can be solved.
branches.cn: 方程：复制件变成一组可求解的关系。

branches.en: THE MACHINE COPY: equations are run, and shapes are built and lit inside a screen.
branches.cn: 机器复制件：方程被运行，形体在屏幕里被搭起并打光。

branches.en: THE MONEY COPY: the same stand-in is pointed at income, cost and value.
branches.cn: 钱的复制件：同一个替身被指向收入、成本与价值。

branches.en: THE HUMAN COPY: a body poses for a garment, a person copies a behaviour, fingers press clay into shape.
branches.cn: 人的复制件：身体替服装摆姿势，人模仿一种行为，手指把黏土压成形。

intro.en: Modeling is built from the Latin measure word modus and the English activity suffix -ing.
intro.cn: modeling 由拉丁语「量度」词 modus 与英语活动后缀 -ing 构成。

latinIntro.en: Latin modus gives modulus and the reconstructed diminutive behind modello; English adds the activity suffix to model.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 modus 衍生 modulus 与 modello 背后的重构指小形式；英语再给 model 加上活动后缀。

items.example: The root supplies the idea of a measured stand-in.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根提供「量出来的替身」这一念头。

items.meaning: a small measure; a standard unit
items.example: The small unit is the first model.
items.exampleCN: 这个小单位就是最初的模型。

items.example: Italian shaped the word that French passed to English.
items.exampleCN: 意大利语定形了这个词，法语再传给英语。

items.example: French carried the word across the Channel.
items.exampleCN: 法语把这个词带过海峡。

items.meaning: a copy; a pattern; to shape
items.example: English widened the copy to people and products.
items.exampleCN: 英语把复制件扩展到人与产品。

items.meaning: the work of making or using models
items.meaningCN: 制作或使用模型的工作
items.example: The suffix names the ongoing work.
items.exampleCN: 后缀命名持续进行的工作。

items.example: The agent suffix names the hand at the table.
items.exampleCN: 施动后缀点出桌边的那双手。

items.example: The same small measure builds a part.
items.exampleCN: 同一个「小量度」构成了部件。

items.example: The adjective keeps the abstract side of modus.
items.exampleCN: 形容词保留 modus 抽象的一面。

items.example: The prefix repeats the shaping.

definition_zh: 模型；按比例缩小的复制品；模特；模范；产品的型号；（科学、数学或计算机的）简化表示；按模型塑造；以……为原型
definition_en: a small copy or simplified representation of something, a person who poses, an example worth copying, or the act of shaping something after a pattern
core_image: 桌上摆着一辆按比例缩小的木制车身，旁边摊着同样线条的图纸
scene: 展厅中央摆着一辆缩小一半的样车，观众围着看比例与线条。The clay model shows the new body shape before any metal is cut.
sceneCN: 这里指按比例做成的实物样件（第 1 个义项：缩小的复制品）；句意为这个黏土样件在任何金属被切割之前就展示了新车身的形状。图中可辨识物件：展台、样车、比例尺、射灯。

pos.zh: 模型；复制品；模特；模范；型号
制作模型；塑造；展示服装；以……为原型

senses.title: A small copy of a thing
senses.definition: a representation of an object, usually smaller and often built to scale
senses.definitionCN: 某物的再现，通常更小，且常按比例制作
senses.example: The museum displayed a model of the ship.
senses.exampleCN: 博物馆展出了那艘船的模型。
senses.why: The word began as a measured pattern, and the first thing a pattern produces is a reduced copy.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最初指量出来的样板，而样板造出的第一件东西就是缩小的复制件。

senses.title: A person who poses
senses.titleCN: 摆姿势供人描绘或拍摄的人
senses.definition: a person who poses for artists, photographers or fashion shows
senses.definitionCN: 为画家、摄影师或时装表演摆姿势的人
senses.example: She worked as a model for a clothing catalogue.
senses.exampleCN: 她为一份服装目录做模特。
senses.why: A living body can also stand in for an ideal body, so the copy became a person.
senses.whyCN: 活人的身体也能充当理想身体的替身，于是复制件变成了人。

senses.title: An example worth copying
senses.definition: a person or thing whose behaviour is held up for others to imitate
senses.definitionCN: 其行为被举出来供他人模仿的人或事物
senses.example: Older students serve as models for the younger ones.
senses.exampleCN: 高年级学生为低年级学生做榜样。
senses.why: Once a copy is approved, it becomes the pattern that the next copy must follow.
senses.whyCN: 一旦某个复制件被认可，它就变成下一个复制件必须遵循的样板。

senses.title: A version of a product
senses.definition: one of the versions in which a product is made and sold
senses.definitionCN: 产品被制造与出售的若干版本之一
senses.example: The new model has a longer battery life.
senses.exampleCN: 新型号的电池续航更长。
senses.why: Factories issue each version as a pattern to be copied on the line, so the version itself is called a model.
senses.whyCN: 工厂把每个版本当作流水线上要复制的样板发下去，于是版本本身就被称为型号。

senses.title: A simplified scientific picture
senses.definition: a simplified description of a system that keeps its main features and drops the rest
senses.definitionCN: 保留主要特征、舍弃其余细节的系统简化描述
senses.example: The model explains how heat moves through the wall.
senses.exampleCN: 这个模型解释了热如何穿过墙壁。
senses.why: Science replaces the whole object with a stand-in small enough to reason about.
senses.whyCN: 科学用一个小到可以推理的替身来取代整个对象。

senses.title: A set of equations
senses.definition: a mathematical representation whose relations can be solved or simulated
senses.definitionCN: 一种关系可被求解或模拟的数学表示
senses.example: A simple model predicts the queue length.
senses.exampleCN: 一个简单模型能预测排队长度。
senses.why: When the copy is made of relations rather than material, it can be calculated.
senses.whyCN: 当复制件的材质从实物换成关系，它就可以被计算。

senses.title: A computer representation
senses.definition: a program and its data built to imitate a system's behaviour
senses.definitionCN: 为模仿系统行为而建立的程序及其数据
senses.example: Engineers ran the model overnight to test the design.
senses.exampleCN: 工程师整夜运行模型来检验设计。
senses.why: The calculating copy finally moved into a machine, where it could be run again and again.
senses.whyCN: 会计算的复制件最终搬进机器，可以在那里一遍遍运行。

senses.title: To shape something
senses.definition: to form a material into a shape, especially by hand
senses.definitionCN: 把材料做成某种形状，尤指用手
senses.example: He modeled the figure in clay.
senses.exampleCN: 他用黏土塑出那个人像。
senses.why: The verb returns to the workshop: the hand making the copy is the oldest action in the word.
senses.whyCN: 动词回到工坊：手做出复制件，是这个词里最古老的动作。

senses.title: To display clothes
senses.definition: to wear clothes for photographs or a show in order to display them
senses.definitionCN: 穿着服装供拍照或走秀以展示它们
senses.example: They model winter coats in the show.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在秀场上展示冬季外套。
senses.why: The posing sense became a verb when the profession turned the body into a display surface.
senses.whyCN: 当这一职业把身体变成展示面，摆姿势这层意思就动词化了。

senses.title: To base something on
senses.definition: to build or design something using another thing as the pattern
senses.definitionCN: 以另一事物为样板来建造或设计
senses.example: The design was modeled on a fishing boat.
senses.exampleCN: 这个设计是以一艘渔船为原型做的。
senses.why: The noun's pattern sense became a verb of copying, which is the last step in the chain.
senses.whyCN: 名词的样板义变成表示复制的动词，这是整条链上的最后一步。

intro.en: Model entered English from French modelle, from Italian modello, from a reconstructed Vulgar Latin diminutive of modulus 'small measure'. The Latin base is modus 'measure'.
intro.cn: model 经法语 modelle、意大利语 modello 进入英语，更早是俗拉丁语中 modulus「小量度」的一个重构指小形式；拉丁语基底为 modus「量度」。

items.en: Latin modus meant measure, manner or limit and underlies mode, moderate and modulus.
items.cn: 拉丁 modus 指量度、方式或限度，是 mode、moderate 与 modulus 的基底。

items.en: Modulus, a small measure or standard unit, was used of a mould, a model and a rhythmic unit.
items.cn: modulus 指小量度或标准单位，曾用于模具、模型与节律单位。

items.en: A Vulgar Latin diminutive of modulus is reconstructed behind the Italian and French words; it is a reconstructed form rather than an attested record.
items.cn: 意大利语与法语词背后的俗拉丁语指小形式为重构所得，是重构形式，并非有记录的词。

items.en: Italian modello named a small copy or a pattern, and the artist's model of the Renaissance made the word common.
items.cn: 意大利语 modello 指小复制件或样板；文艺复兴时期画家的模特使这个词通行。

items.en: French modelle carried the word into English in the sixteenth century, first as an architect's pattern and a small copy.
items.cn: 法语 modelle 在十六世纪把词带入英语，最初指建筑师的样板与小复制件。

items.en: English extended the copy to a posing person, then to an example, a product version and a scientific schema; the verb followed in the seventeenth century.
items.cn: 英语把这层复制义扩展到摆姿势的人，再扩展到榜样、产品型号与科学图式；动词用法在十七世纪跟上。

note.en: The first group looks or sounds like model; the second group names neighbouring ideas in the same field.
note.cn: 第一组在形音上与「model」相近；第二组是同一领域里意思相邻的其他说法。

entries.definition: A measured unit or separable part, from the same small-measure root.
entries.definitionCN: 量度单位或可拆分部件，同出那个「小量度」词根。

entries.definition: Relating to mode or manner, as in grammar or music; it keeps the abstract side of modus.
entries.definitionCN: 与方式或调式相关，如语法或音乐；它保留 modus 抽象的一面。

entries.definition: To interfere in others' affairs; it looks close but has no connection with measure.
entries.definitionCN: 插手他人的事；形近，但与「量度」无关。

entries.definition: A person who builds models, formed with the agent suffix.
entries.definitionCN: 建造模型的人，由施动后缀构成。

entries.definition: A hollow shape for casting, from Latin modulus but through a different path; it is the tool, not the copy.
entries.definitionCN: 用于浇铸的空腔形状，虽源于拉丁 modulus，但走的是另一条路径；它是工具，不是复制件。

entries.definition: A copy made to match an original closely, often at full size.
entries.definitionCN: 为贴近原物而做的复制件，常为原尺寸。

entries.definition: The first full working version from which later copies are developed.
entries.definitionCN: 第一个可工作的完整版本，后续复制件由它发展而来。

entries.definition: An original pattern or ideal that later things are said to follow.
entries.definitionCN: 后世事物被认为遵循的原初范式或理想。

entries.definition: An imitation that is run or observed rather than held in the hand.
entries.definitionCN: 被运行或观察、而非拿在手里的仿制品。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real Latin measure word, the real family and real fixed phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用真实的拉丁「量度」词、真实同族词与真实固定搭配。

normal.en: Latin modus means measure, so a model is a thing measured out to stand for another.
normal.cn: 拉丁 modus 意为量度，因此模型就是量出来代替另一物的东西。

normal.en: The family runs model, modeling, modeler, modeled and remodel.
normal.cn: 同族词有 model、modeling、modeler、modeled 与 remodel。

normal.en: Fixed phrases cover the senses: scale model, role model, fashion model, business model.
normal.cn: 固定说法覆盖各义：比例模型、榜样、时装模特、商业模式。

normal.en: The verb phrase model on keeps the old pattern sense alive.
normal.cn: 动词短语 model on 保留着古老的样板义。

normal.en: British English writes modelled and modelling with a doubled l.
normal.cn: 英式英语把过去式与现在分词写成双写 l 的 modelled 与 modelling。

abstract.en: A model is a stand-in you can hold, rotate and point at.
abstract.cn: 模型是一个能拿住、转动并指给人看的替身。

abstract.en: A role model is the same stand-in made of a person's conduct.
abstract.cn: 榜样是用一个人的行为做成的同一个替身。

abstract.en: A computer model is a copy with no weight, run again and again.
abstract.cn: 计算机模型是一个没有重量的复制件，可以一遍遍运行。

examples.en: The engineer built a scale model before the full bridge was ordered.
examples.cn: 工程师在整座桥下单之前做了一个比例模型。

examples.en: Her calm reply became a model for the whole team.
examples.cn: 她沉着的回答成了整个团队的榜样。

examples.en: The lab models the river's flow on a supercomputer.
examples.cn: 实验室在一台超级计算机上模拟这条河的流量。

root: 拉丁 modus「量度」→ modulus「小量度」→ 俗拉丁语指小形式（重构形式）→ 意大利 modello／法语 modelle→ 英语 model。与 mode、moderate、module 同根；与 meddle「插手」形近但无词源关系。

sensesIntro.en: Ten senses follow one measured stand-in: a reduced copy, a posing body, an example, a product version, a scientific picture, equations, a computer representation, the act of shaping, the act of displaying, and the act of basing on.
sensesIntro.cn: 十个义项跟着同一个量出来的替身：缩小的复制件、摆姿势的身体、榜样、产品型号、科学图景、方程、计算机表示、塑造的动作、展示的动作，以及以之为原型的动作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a scaled wooden body on a table, with the same lines drawn on paper beside it.
core.cn: 核心意象：桌上放着一具按比例缩小的木制车身，旁边摊着画出同样线条的图纸。

branches.en: THE COPY MADE BY HAND: a reduced object is built, and the hand that builds it is the oldest sense.
branches.cn: 亲手做出的复制件：一个缩小的物件被造出来，造它的那只手是最古老的一层。

branches.en: THE POSING BODY: a living person stands in for an ideal body, and the same act becomes a verb.
branches.cn: 摆姿势的身体：活人替理想身体站台，同一个动作又动词化。

branches.en: THE APPROVED PATTERN: a copy that has won approval becomes the thing others must follow.
branches.cn: 被认可的样板：赢得认可的复制件变成他人必须跟随的东西。

branches.en: THE PRODUCT VERSION: a factory issues each version as the pattern to copy on the line.
branches.cn: 产品型号：工厂把每个版本当作流水线上要复制的样板。

branches.en: THE CALCULATED STAND-IN: a picture, a set of equations, a program, or the act of building on a pattern.
branches.cn: 被计算的替身：一幅图景、一组方程、一个程序，或以样板为据来建造的动作。

sceneCN: 这里指由网络搭起、并非实体会面的（第 4 个义项：线上进行的）；句意为团队有一半人在虚拟会议室里参加评审。图中可辨识物件：屏幕、长桌、耳机、摄像头。

pos.zh: 实质上的；虚拟的；模拟的；线上的

derivatives.zh: 几乎；实际上；以虚拟方式

senses.title: Effective without the name
senses.definition: true or effective in practice even if not formally or officially so
senses.definitionCN: 在实际效果上成立，即使名义或形式上并非如此
senses.example: The agreement was a virtual surrender.
senses.exampleCN: 那份协议实质上就是投降。
senses.why: The root is power, so the first sense says the thing has the effect even when it lacks the label.
senses.whyCN: 词根是「力量」，因此第一层意思是：即使没有名义，事情也已产生效果。

senses.title: Created by software
senses.definition: existing as a software construct rather than as a separate physical object
senses.definitionCN: 作为软件构造存在，而非独立的物理实体
senses.example: The machine runs two virtual servers.
senses.exampleCN: 这台机器运行着两台虚拟服务器。
senses.why: Computing took the old 'effective but not formal' sense and made it literal: the machine is real only inside software.
senses.whyCN: 计算领域把古老的「有效但非正式」义变成字面事实：机器只在软件内部存在。

senses.title: Immersive and computer-generated
senses.definition: describing an environment produced by a computer that a person can enter and interact with
senses.definitionCN: 描述由计算机生成、人可进入并互动的环境
senses.example: The virtual world has its own weather.
senses.exampleCN: 这个虚拟世界有自己的天气。
senses.why: Here the simulated thing is not a server but a whole place, which is the largest object the word can cover.
senses.whyCN: 这里被模拟的不是服务器，而是一整个场所，这是这个词能覆盖的最大对象。

senses.title: Held online
senses.definition: carried out through a network instead of in one physical place
senses.definitionCN: 通过网络而非在同一实地点进行
senses.example: The class moved to a virtual room.
senses.exampleCN: 课程搬到了虚拟教室。
senses.why: A meeting needs only the effect of togetherness, and a network can supply that effect without the room.
senses.whyCN: 会议只需要「聚在一起」的效果，网络无需那间屋子就能提供这种效果。

senses.title: Powerful enough for the name
senses.titleCN: 强大到足以当得起这个称呼
senses.definition: having so much of a quality that the ordinary word for it seems justified
senses.definitionCN: 某种性质如此充分，以至于平常的说法也显得合理
senses.example: A virtual army of volunteers joined the clean-up.
senses.exampleCN: 一支事实上的大军般的志愿者加入了清理。
senses.why: The oldest sense survives whole: not the title, but the power behind it.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的那层意思完整地留了下来：不是名号，而是名号背后的力量。

senses.title: An optical apparent image
senses.definition: an image formed by rays that appear to meet but do not actually pass through the point
senses.definitionCN: 由看似相交、实际并不经过该点的光线所形成的像
senses.example: The lens forms a virtual image behind the mirror.
senses.exampleCN: 透镜在镜后形成一个虚像。
senses.why: Optics adopted the word for an image that has the look of a thing without the thing being there.
senses.whyCN: 光学借这个词指一个有其形而无其物的像。

senses.title: A transient particle
senses.definition: a particle that exists only briefly as an intermediate state and cannot be observed directly
senses.definitionCN: 只作为中间状态短暂存在、无法被直接观测的粒子
senses.example: A virtual particle appears and vanishes.
senses.exampleCN: 一个虚粒子出现又消失。
senses.why: Physics pushes the 'effective but not directly present' sense to its smallest scale.
senses.whyCN: 物理学把「有效但不直接在场」这层意思推到最小的尺度。

senses.title: A networked organization
senses.definition: describing a team or company that works across places through networks rather than in one office
senses.definitionCN: 描述通过网络跨地点运作、而非集中在一间办公室的团队或公司
senses.example: The virtual team spans five time zones.
senses.exampleCN: 这个虚拟团队横跨五个时区。
senses.why: An organization too can be held together by effect rather than by walls.
senses.whyCN: 一个组织同样可以靠效果而不是靠墙壁维系。

senses.title: Nearly complete in a market
senses.definition: holding so large a share of a market that competition is effectively absent
senses.definitionCN: 在市场中所占份额之大，使竞争实际上不存在
senses.example: The platform holds a virtual monopoly.
senses.exampleCN: 这个平台实质上处于垄断地位。
senses.why: The same logic returns to economics: the name is missing, the power is not.
senses.whyCN: 同一套逻辑回到经济领域：名号缺席，力量却没有缺席。

intro.en: Virtual comes from Late Latin virtualis 'having power', from Latin virtus 'virtue, strength', from vir 'man'. The modern computing sense is a twentieth-century extension of 'effective but not formally so'.
intro.cn: virtual 来自晚期拉丁 virtualis「有力量的」，上溯拉丁 virtus「德性、力量」与 vir「人」。现代计算义是二十世纪对「有效但非正式」这一旧义的延伸。

items.en: Latin vir meant a man, and the derived virtus named the qualities that made a man effective: courage, worth and strength.
items.cn: 拉丁 vir 指男人，其派生词 virtus 指使人有力量的那些品质：勇气、价值与力量。

items.en: Virtualis meant having virtue or power, able to produce an effect, rather than being a mere appearance.
items.cn: virtualis 指具有德性或力量、能够产生效果，而不是仅有外表。

items.en: Medieval philosophy used virtualiter for what exists in effect or potentially, even without the name or the separate form.
items.cn: 中世纪哲学用 virtualiter 指以效果或潜能方式存在，即使没有名号或独立形态。

items.en: English virtual first meant effective in practice although not formally recognised, and this is still sense one.
items.cn: 英语 virtual 最初指实际有效但未获正式承认，这仍是第一义。

items.en: Optics called an image virtual when the rays only appear to meet, and physics later named transient intermediate particles virtual.
items.cn: 光学把光线只是看似相交的像称为虚像，物理学后来把短暂存在的中间态粒子称为虚粒子。

items.en: From the 1950s computing used virtual for memory, machines and networks that exist only as software constructs; virtual reality was popularised in the late 1980s.
items.cn: 二十世纪五十年代起，计算领域用 virtual 指只在软件构造中存在内存、机器与网络；虚拟现实一词在八十年代末流行。

note.en: The first group looks or sounds like virtual; the second group names neighbouring ideas in the same field.
note.cn: 第一组在形音上与「virtual」相近；第二组是同一领域里意思相邻的其他说法。

entries.definition: The adverb meaning almost or in effect; it is the everyday partner of the adjective.
entries.definitionCN: 意为「几乎、实际上」的副词，是这个形容词的日常搭档。

entries.definition: The quality of being virtual, used in philosophy and in computing studies.
entries.definitionCN: 虚拟性，用于哲学与计算研究。

entries.definition: To turn a physical resource into a software construct.
entries.definitionCN: 把物理资源变成软件构造。

entries.definition: Having moral virtue, from the same virtus; it kept the moral branch.
entries.definitionCN: 有德行的，同出 virtus；它保留了道德那一支。

entries.definition: Manly or energetic, from vir; it kept the bodily branch rather than the effective one.
entries.definitionCN: 有男子气概的，来自 vir；它保留身体那一支，而非效果那一支。

entries.definition: Made to imitate something real, usually by a machine.
entries.definitionCN: 为模仿真实之物而造，通常由机器完成。

entries.definition: Producing the intended result, whether or not the form is official.
entries.definitionCN: 产生预期结果，不论形式是否正式。

entries.definition: Connected through a network and therefore not tied to one place.
entries.definitionCN: 经网络连接，因此不受单一地点限制。

entries.definition: Present in effect though not stated openly.
entries.definitionCN: 实际存在却未明说。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real Latin power word, the real family and real technical phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用真实的拉丁「力量」词、真实同族词与真实技术搭配。

normal.en: The root virtus means strength, so virtual first meant having the power without the name.
normal.cn: 词根 virtus 意为力量，因此 virtual 最初指有其实力而无其名。

normal.en: The family runs virtual, virtually, virtuality, virtualize and virtualization.
normal.cn: 同族词有 virtual、virtually、virtuality、virtualize 与 virtualization。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the computing senses: virtual machine, virtual memory, virtual team, virtual meeting.
normal.cn: 固定说法标出计算义：虚拟机、虚拟内存、虚拟团队、线上会议。

normal.en: Optics calls an image virtual when the rays only appear to meet.
normal.cn: 光学把光线只是看似相交的像称为虚像。

normal.en: Physics calls a short-lived intermediate particle virtual.
normal.cn: 物理学把短暂的中间态粒子称为虚粒子。

abstract.en: A virtual room is a room made of effect, not of walls.
abstract.cn: 虚拟房间是用效果而非墙壁做成的房间。

abstract.en: A virtual monopoly has the power of a monopoly without the legal title.
abstract.cn: 实质垄断拥有垄断的力量，却没有那纸法律名号。

abstract.en: What is virtual is felt before it is touched.
abstract.cn: 虚拟之物总是先被感受到，才被触碰。

examples.en: The old factory is now a virtual museum that anyone can enter online.
examples.cn: 那座旧工厂如今成了任何人都能在线上进入的虚拟博物馆。

examples.en: With three suppliers left, the company had a virtual monopoly.
examples.cn: 只剩三家供应商时，这家公司已处于实质垄断。

examples.en: The training uses a virtual machine, so a mistake harms nothing.
examples.cn: 培训使用虚拟机，因此操作失误不会造成损害。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「微（音近）+ 求」——摸不到却求得到效果，就是虚拟

root: 拉丁 vir「人」→ virtus「德性、力量」→ 晚期拉丁 virtualis「有力量的、能生效的」→ 英语 virtual。由「有效但非正式」发展为「软件模拟」「光学虚像」「线上进行」等义。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses follow one idea of power without a body: effective in practice, simulated in software, immersive in a headset, online, overwhelming in force, apparent in optics, transient in physics, networked in business, and near-total in a market.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项跟着同一个「有力而无实体」的念头：实际有效、软件模拟、头显沉浸、线上进行、力量压倒、光学虚像、物理暂现、商业联网、市场近乎独占。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a complete office glowing on a screen, every chair visible and none of them touchable.
core.cn: 核心意象：一间完整的办公室在屏幕上发亮，每把椅子都看得见，却一把也摸不到。

branches.en: THE EFFECT WITHOUT THE NAME: the thing works before it is officially called anything.
branches.cn: 有名无实之外的另一面：事情在获得正式称呼之前就已经生效。

branches.en: POWER IN A MACHINE OR A MASS: software constructs behave like real machines, and sheer numbers act like an army.
branches.cn: 机器或人群中的力量：软件构造像真机器一样运转，数量本身也像一支军队那样起作用。

branches.en: THE SIMULATED PLACE: a headset world, an online room and a networked team all substitute effect for location.
branches.cn: 被模拟的场所：头显世界、线上房间与联网团队都用效果替代地点。

branches.en: THE APPARENT BODY: an optical image and a transient particle both look present without being present.
branches.cn: 看似在场的实体：光学虚像与暂现粒子都显得在场，实际并不在场。

branches.en: THE HELD MARKET: a share so large that the name of monopoly is unnecessary.
branches.cn: 被占住的市场：份额大到垄断之名已不必要。

intro.en: Virtual is built on the Latin word for strength, with a Late Latin adjective and an English adjective ending.
intro.cn: virtual 建立在拉丁语「力量」词之上，经由晚期拉丁形容词与英语形容词词尾构成。

latinIntro.en: Latin vir gives virtus, Late Latin virtus gives virtualis, and English keeps the adjective virtual with its adverb virtually.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 vir 衍生 virtus，晚期拉丁 virtus 衍生 virtualis，英语保留形容词 virtual 及其副词 virtually。

definition_zh: 虚拟化；把物理资源抽象成多个独立虚拟环境的技术；服务器、桌面、网络或存储资源的虚拟化
definition_en: the creation of a virtual version of a resource, such as a server, desktop, network or storage system, so that it can be used independently of its physical form
core_image: 一台机柜里的服务器被划分成几个互不相见的隔间，每个隔间都以为自己独占整台机器
scene: 机房管理员把一台物理服务器的资源切成几个互不干扰的运行空间，各自装系统。Virtualization lets one machine host several isolated systems.
sceneCN: 这里指把物理资源抽象成多个独立虚拟环境（第 2 个义项：服务器虚拟化）；句意为虚拟化让一台机器承载多个隔离的系统。图中可辨识物件：机柜、服务器、分隔框、指示灯。

pos.zh: 虚拟化；资源抽象；虚拟环境技术

derivatives.zh: 虚拟化工具；虚拟化实施者

senses.title: Making one resource look like many
senses.titleCN: 把一份资源看成许多份
senses.definition: the general act of abstracting a physical resource so that users see logical resources instead
senses.definitionCN: 把物理资源抽象化、使用户看到逻辑资源的一般做法
senses.example: Virtualization hides the number of disks behind one pool.
senses.exampleCN: 虚拟化把磁盘数量藏在一个存储池后面。
senses.why: The verb virtualize plus -ation names the act of turning something real into something effective in software.
senses.whyCN: 动词「使虚拟化」加名词后缀「过程」，命名的是把真实之物变成软件中有效之物的动作。

senses.title: Splitting a server
senses.definition: the use of a hypervisor to run several separate operating systems on one physical server
senses.definitionCN: 用虚拟机监控程序在一台物理服务器上运行多个相互独立的操作系统
senses.example: Server virtualization cut the number of racks by half.
senses.exampleCN: 服务器虚拟化把机柜数量减少了一半。
senses.why: One machine can supply the effect of many, which is exactly the old 'effective, not physical' idea.
senses.whyCN: 一台机器能提供许多台的效果，这正是古老的「有效而非实体」那个念头。

senses.title: Desktop virtualization
senses.definition: the running of a user's desktop on a remote server and its delivery to a local screen
senses.definitionCN: 用户在远程服务器上运行桌面，再把画面送到本地屏幕
senses.example: Desktop virtualization lets staff log in from any machine.
senses.exampleCN: 桌面虚拟化让员工从任何一台机器登录。
senses.why: The desk itself becomes a software construct, so the workplace travels instead of the computer.
senses.whyCN: 办公桌本身成了软件构造，于是流动的是工作场所，而不是电脑。

senses.title: Network virtualization
senses.definition: the creation of several logical networks on top of shared physical links and switches
senses.definitionCN: 在共享的物理链路与交换机之上建立多个逻辑网络
senses.example: Network virtualization creates separate paths on one switch.
senses.exampleCN: 网络虚拟化在一台交换机上分出彼此独立的路径。
senses.why: Links that once belonged to one cable can now be divided by software, like lanes painted on a road.
senses.whyCN: 原本属于一根线缆的链路，如今可由软件划分，就像在一条路上画出车道。

senses.title: Storage virtualization
senses.definition: the pooling of separate physical storage devices into one logical store that can be managed as a unit
senses.definitionCN: 把分散的物理存储设备汇成一个可按整体管理的逻辑存储
senses.example: Storage virtualization merged four arrays into one pool.
senses.exampleCN: 存储虚拟化把四组阵列并成一个存储池。
senses.why: Many boxes become one box on the screen, which is the same abstraction applied to capacity.
senses.whyCN: 许多盒子在屏幕上变成一个盒子，这是同一套抽象用在容量上。

senses.title: Operating-system-level virtualization
senses.definition: the isolation of applications in containers that share one kernel instead of each carrying a full system
senses.definitionCN: 让应用在共享同一内核的容器中彼此隔离，而不必各自携带完整系统
senses.example: OS-level virtualization starts a container in seconds.
senses.exampleCN: 操作系统级虚拟化在几秒内启动一个容器。
senses.why: Instead of faking whole machines, this branch fakes only the boundaries around a process.
senses.whyCN: 这一支不再伪造整台机器，只伪造进程周围的边界。

senses.title: Application virtualization
senses.definition: the delivery of an application in an isolated package so that it runs without a normal installation
senses.definitionCN: 把应用打包隔离后交付，使其无需常规安装即可运行
senses.example: Application virtualization runs the old program without installing it.
senses.exampleCN: 应用虚拟化让旧程序无需安装就能运行。
senses.why: The smallest thing that can be made virtual is a single program, and the word reaches its narrowest point.
senses.whyCN: 能被虚拟化的最小对象是单个程序，这个词也走到最窄处。

senses.title: Resource abstraction as a principle
senses.definition: the general computing principle of separating logical resources from the hardware that provides them
senses.definitionCN: 把逻辑资源与提供它们的硬件分开的一般计算原则
senses.example: Virtualization is the first step in building a private cloud.
senses.exampleCN: 虚拟化是搭建私有云的第一步。
senses.why: Once abstraction is named as a principle, it becomes the foundation of cloud and container systems.
senses.whyCN: 当抽象被命名为一项原则，它就成了云与容器系统的基础。

intro.en: Virtualization is virtual plus the verb suffix -ize and the noun suffix -ation. Virtual goes back to Late Latin virtualis 'having power', from virtus. The computing sense developed in the 1960s and spread with x86 virtual machines in the 2000s.
intro.cn: virtualization 由 virtual 加动词后缀 -ize 与名词后缀 -ation 构成。virtual 上溯晚期拉丁 virtualis「有力量的」，源自 virtus。计算义在二十世纪六十年代形成，并随二十一世纪的 x86 虚拟机普及。

items.en: Virtualis meant having power or producing an effect, and English virtual kept that sense of effectiveness without a separate form.
items.cn: virtualis 指有力量或能产生效果，英语 virtual 保留了这种「有效而无独立形态」的意思。

items.en: The verb suffix -ize, from Greek through Latin, turns an adjective into a verb meaning to make or to render.
items.cn: 动词后缀 -ize 经拉丁语来自希腊语，把形容词变成「使成为」的动词。

items.en: The noun suffix -ation, from Latin -atio, names the process or the result of that verb.
items.cn: 名词后缀 -ation 来自拉丁 -atio，命名该动词的过程或结果。

items.en: IBM's CP-67 system in the late 1960s ran several virtual machines on one mainframe and established the term in computing.
items.cn: 二十世纪六十年代末，万国商业机器的 CP-67 系统在一台大型机上运行多台虚拟机，使该词在计算领域立住。

items.en: Virtualization of ordinary server hardware spread after VMware's 1999 release, when many small systems could share one physical machine.
items.cn: 普通服务器硬件的虚拟化在 VMware 一九九九年发布后普及，许多小系统得以共用一台物理机。

items.en: From the 2000s, operating-system-level containers added a lighter branch, so virtualization now covers machines, desktops, networks, storage and processes.
items.cn: 二十一世纪起，操作系统级容器增加了更轻的一支，虚拟化由此覆盖机器、桌面、网络、存储与进程。

note.en: The first group looks or sounds like virtualization; the second group names neighbouring ideas in the same field.
note.cn: 第一组在形音上与「virtualization」相近；第二组是同一领域里意思相邻的其他说法。

entries.definition: The adjective describing what exists in effect or in software rather than as a separate object.
entries.definitionCN: 描述以效果或软件形式存在、而非独立实物的形容词。

entries.definition: The verb meaning to turn a physical resource into a logical one.
entries.definitionCN: 指把物理资源变成逻辑资源的动词。

entries.definition: The past participle used as an adjective for resources already turned into software form.
entries.definitionCN: 过去分词作形容词，指已转成软件形态的资源。

entries.definition: The adverb meaning almost or in effect; it is not the adverb of this noun.
entries.definitionCN: 意为「几乎、实际上」的副词，并不是这个名词的副词。

entries.definition: The state of being virtual, used in philosophy and media studies.
entries.definitionCN: 虚拟状态，用于哲学与媒介研究。

entries.definition: The act of removing detail so that a simpler logical view remains.
entries.definitionCN: 去除细节、留下更简单逻辑视图的做法。

entries.definition: Imitation of one system by another so that the same software can run.
entries.definitionCN: 用一个系统模仿另一个，使同样的软件得以运行。

entries.definition: Dividing a resource into separate parts, often without a full virtual machine.
entries.definitionCN: 把资源分成若干独立部分，通常不涉及完整虚拟机。

entries.definition: Packaging an application with its dependencies so it runs isolated on a shared kernel.
entries.definitionCN: 把应用与依赖打包，使其在共享内核上隔离运行。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real suffixes, the real computing history and real product phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用真实后缀、真实计算史与真实产品搭配。

normal.en: The verb virtualize plus -ation simply names the process of making something virtual.
normal.cn: 动词 virtualize 加 -ation，直接命名「使某物虚拟化」的过程。

normal.en: The family runs virtual, virtualize, virtualized, virtualization and virtuality.
normal.cn: 同族词有 virtual、virtualize、virtualized、virtualization 与 virtuality。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the branches: server, desktop, network, storage and application virtualization.
normal.cn: 固定说法标出各支：服务器、桌面、网络、存储与应用虚拟化。

normal.en: A hypervisor is the program that runs several virtual machines on one host.
normal.cn: 虚拟机监控程序是在一台宿主上运行多台虚拟机的程序。

normal.en: Containers share one kernel, which makes them lighter than full virtual machines.
normal.cn: 容器共享一个内核，因此比完整虚拟机更轻。

abstract.en: Virtualization is many rooms drawn inside one building.
abstract.cn: 虚拟化是在一栋楼里画出许多房间。

abstract.en: Each room believes it has the whole building, and none of them can see the walls of the others.
abstract.cn: 每个房间都以为自己拥有整栋楼，却看不见别的房间的墙。

abstract.en: The abstraction is a promise: the logical view holds even when the hardware changes.
abstract.cn: 抽象是一句承诺：即使硬件更换，逻辑视图仍然成立。

examples.en: Virtualization let the lab retire six old servers without losing a single service.
examples.cn: 虚拟化让实验室退役了六台旧服务器却没有丢失任何一项服务。

examples.en: The course explains virtualization before it introduces cloud platforms.
examples.cn: 这门课在介绍云平台之前先讲虚拟化。

examples.en: Storage virtualization made the four arrays look like one large disk.
examples.cn: 存储虚拟化让四组阵列看起来像一块大磁盘。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「虚拟 + 化」——把真的切成假的，每块都以为自己是全部：虚拟化

root: virtual 来自晚期拉丁 virtualis「有力量的」，加 -ize（使成为）与 -ation（过程）构成。计算义自二十世纪六十年代的大型机虚拟机开始，x86 虚拟化在九十年代末普及，容器又添一支。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one abstraction: a resource made logical, a server split, a desktop delivered, a network divided, storage pooled, a kernel shared, an application packaged, and the principle itself.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项跟着同一次抽象：资源被逻辑化、服务器被切开、桌面被送远、网络被划分、存储被汇集、内核被共享、应用被打包，最后是原则本身。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one server divided into sealed compartments, each believing it owns the whole machine.
core.cn: 核心意象：一台服务器被切成若干密封隔间，每个都以为自己独占整台机器。

branches.en: THE GENERAL ACT: a physical thing is replaced by a logical view that behaves the same.
branches.cn: 一般动作：物理之物被一个行为相同的逻辑视图取代。

branches.en: THE SPLIT SERVER: one machine hosts several systems that never meet.
branches.cn: 被切开的服务器：一台机器承载多个永不相见的系统。

branches.en: THE DISTANT DESK: the desktop lives on a server and appears on any screen.
branches.cn: 远方的桌面：桌面住在服务器上，却出现在任何屏幕上。

branches.en: THE DIVIDED AND POOLED RESOURCES: links are split into logical paths, disks are merged into one pool.
branches.cn: 被划分与被汇集的资源：链路分成逻辑路径，磁盘并成一个池。

branches.en: THE LIGHT BRANCHES: containers share a kernel, single applications are packaged, and abstraction becomes a principle.
branches.cn: 更轻的分支：容器共享内核，单个应用被打包，抽象上升为原则。

intro.en: Virtualization is virtual plus -ize plus -ation, built on Late Latin virtualis.
intro.cn: virtualization 是 virtual 加 -ize 再加 -ation，建立在晚期拉丁 virtualis 上。

latinIntro.en: Late Latin virtualis gives English virtual; English adds the Greek-Latin verb suffix -ize and the Latin noun suffix -ation.
latinIntro.cn: 晚期拉丁 virtualis 衍生英语 virtual；英语再加希腊—拉丁动词后缀 -ize 与拉丁名词后缀 -ation。

items.example: The adjective behind the whole family.
items.exampleCN: 整个词族背后的形容词。

items.example: English extended it into computing.
The verb names the change.
The noun names the process.
The participle describes the result.

items.meaning: a tool or person that virtualizes
items.example: The agent suffix names the doer.

items.meaningCN: 表示「使成为」的动词后缀
items.example: It builds virtualize and modernize.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 virtualize 与 modernize 等词。

items.meaningCN: 表示过程或结果的名词后缀
items.example: It builds virtualization and organization.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 virtualization 与 organization 等词。

items.meaning: a monitor that runs virtual machines
items.meaningCN: 运行虚拟机的监控程序
items.example: The word names the tool that performs this work.
items.exampleCN: 该词命名执行这项工作的工具。

definition_zh: 虚拟现实；由计算机生成、可沉浸其中的三维环境；沉浸式头显技术及相关产业
definition_en: a computer-generated environment that a person can enter and interact with, usually through a headset
core_image: 参观者戴上头显，眼前出现一座可以走动查看的古罗马市场
scene: 参观者戴上头显，眼前出现一座可以走动查看的古罗马市场。Virtual reality let her walk through the market without leaving the room.
sceneCN: 这里指由计算机生成、可沉浸其中的三维环境（第 1 个义项：沉浸式虚拟环境）；句意为虚拟现实让她足不出户就走遍了那座市场。图中可辨识物件：头显、手柄、市场柱廊、地毯边界。

pos.zh: 虚拟现实；沉浸式计算机生成环境

senses.title: An immersive generated environment
senses.definition: a three-dimensional world produced by a computer that a person can enter and move around in
senses.definitionCN: 由计算机生成、人可以进入并在其中移动的三维世界
senses.example: The museum built a virtual reality of the drowned town.
senses.exampleCN: 博物馆造了一个被淹小镇的虚拟现实。
senses.why: Virtual supplies the software-made existence and reality supplies the claim that it is a world, not a picture.
senses.whyCN: 前一词提供软件造出的存在，后一词提供「这是一个世界而非一幅画」的主张。

senses.title: The technology and industry
senses.definition: the hardware, software and business built around immersive computer environments
senses.definitionCN: 围绕沉浸式计算机环境形成的硬件、软件与产业
senses.example: Virtual reality is now a small but growing industry.
senses.exampleCN: 虚拟现实如今是一个规模不大却在增长的产业。
senses.why: When a phrase names a medium, it also names the companies that make and sell it.
senses.whyCN: 当一个说法命名一种媒介，它也命名了制造与销售它的公司。

senses.title: The headset experience
senses.definition: the experience of wearing a display close to the eyes that fills the field of view
senses.definitionCN: 戴上贴近双眼、占满视野的显示器所获得的体验
senses.example: The film is shown in virtual reality, with the audience seated in moving chairs.
senses.exampleCN: 这部影片以虚拟现实方式放映，观众坐在会动的椅子上。
senses.why: The headset is the door through which the generated world becomes a bodily experience.
senses.whyCN: 头显是那扇门，生成的世界由它变成身体经验。

senses.title: Training and simulation
senses.definition: the use of generated environments to practise tasks that would be costly or dangerous in life
senses.definitionCN: 用生成环境练习在现实中昂贵或危险的任务
senses.example: Pilots use virtual reality to rehearse emergency landings.
senses.exampleCN: 飞行员用虚拟现实演练紧急着陆。
senses.why: If the world is convincing enough, practice inside it transfers to the body outside it.
senses.whyCN: 只要那个世界足够可信，其中的练习就能转移到外面的身体上。

senses.title: Shared social space
senses.definition: a networked generated world in which several people appear to one another as avatars
senses.definitionCN: 若干人以化身相互出现的联网生成世界
senses.example: They held a family reunion in virtual reality.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在一场虚拟现实里办了家庭聚会。
senses.why: A world that several people can enter at once becomes a place where relationships happen.
senses.whyCN: 一个多人可同时进入的世界，就成了关系发生的场所。

senses.title: An art form
senses.definition: a medium in which artists build spaces and experiences rather than flat images
senses.definitionCN: 艺术家在其中搭建空间与体验、而非平面图像的媒介
senses.example: The installation treats virtual reality as sculpture you can walk inside.
senses.exampleCN: 这件装置把虚拟现实当作可以走进去的雕塑。
senses.why: Art has always made stand-in worlds; this one surrounds the viewer instead of facing them.
senses.whyCN: 艺术一向在造替身世界；这一个把观者围住，而不是面对观者。

senses.title: Therapeutic exposure
senses.definition: the controlled presentation of a feared situation in a generated environment as part of therapy
senses.definitionCN: 在生成环境中受控呈现所恐惧的情境，作为治疗的一部分
senses.example: Virtual reality helped him approach the lift without panic.
senses.exampleCN: 虚拟现实帮他不再惊恐地接近电梯。
senses.why: A feared place can be visited safely when it is only effective, not physical.
senses.whyCN: 当可怕的地点只是有效而非实体，人就能安全地造访它。

senses.title: A fictional setting
senses.definition: a generated world presented in a story as a place where characters live or are trapped
senses.definitionCN: 故事中作为人物生活或被困之地的生成世界
senses.example: The novel describes a virtual reality that no one can leave.
senses.exampleCN: 那部小说描写了一个无人能离开的虚拟现实。
senses.why: Fiction uses the technology as a setting, and the phrase becomes a name for a world with rules.
senses.whyCN: 虚构作品把这技术当作设定，这个说法于是成为一种有规则世界的名字。

senses.title: A constructed false reality
senses.titleCN: 被人为构造的虚假现实
senses.definition: a version of reality so shaped by others that it replaces what is actually there
senses.definitionCN: 被他人塑造到取代实际情形的一种现实版本
senses.example: The advertisement sells a virtual reality of perfect families.
senses.exampleCN: 那则广告贩卖一种完美家庭的虚假现实。
senses.why: The oldest sense of virtual is 'effective though not formal', and here the effect has swallowed the fact.
senses.whyCN: 前一词最古老的意思是「有效但非正式」，在这里效果吞掉了事实。

intro.en: Virtual reality joins virtual, from Late Latin virtualis 'having power', and reality, from Latin realis 'of a thing', from res. The phrase was used in French in the 1930s and was popularised in English by Jaron Lanier in 1987; the exact first use of the English phrase is source uncertain.
intro.cn: virtual reality 由 virtual（晚期拉丁 virtualis「有力量的」）与 reality（拉丁 realis「事物的」，源自 res）组合。该短语在二十世纪三十年代已见于法语，英语则由贾龙·拉尼尔于一九八七年推广；英语短语最早出现的准确出处来源不确定。

items.en: Late Latin virtualis meant having power or producing an effect, and English virtual kept the sense of what is effective without being a separate object.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁 virtualis 指有力量或能产生效果，英语 virtual 保留了「有效而非独立实物」之义。

items.en: Latin realis meant belonging to a thing, from res 'thing'; English reality names what actually exists rather than what merely appears.
items.cn: 拉丁 realis 指属于某物的，源自 res「事物」；英语 reality 命名实际存在者，而非仅仅显现者。

items.en: French writers used la realite virtuelle in the 1930s for an artificial or imagined reality, a use that predates the headset.
items.cn: 法语作者在二十世纪三十年代已用 la realite virtuelle 指人造或想象的真实，早于头显出现。

items.en: Jaron Lanier is generally credited with popularising the English phrase in 1987, though earlier uses exist and the first written instance is source uncertain.
items.cn: 一般认为贾龙·拉尼尔在一九八七年使英语短语流行，但更早的用法存在，最早书面实例来源不确定。

items.en: Research labs in the late 1980s and 1990s built gloves and head-mounted displays, turning the phrase from an idea into equipment.
items.cn: 二十世纪八十年代末至九十年代，研究实验室造出手套与头戴显示器，把这个短语从想法变成设备。

items.en: Consumer headsets in the 2010s made the phrase common in shops and schools, and it now also names a whole industry.
items.cn: 二十一世纪一十年代的消费级头显使这个短语常见于商店与学校，如今它也指整个产业。

note.en: The first group looks or sounds like virtual reality; the second group names neighbouring ideas in the same field.
note.cn: 第一组在形音上与「virtual reality」相近；第二组是同一领域里意思相邻的其他说法。

entries.definition: The first element, meaning effective or software-made rather than physically separate.
entries.definitionCN: 第一部分，意为有效的或软件造出的，而非独立实体。

entries.definition: The second element, naming what actually exists.
entries.definitionCN: 第二部分，命名实际存在之物。

entries.definition: The abstract quality of being virtual, not a name for the immersive world.
entries.definitionCN: 「虚拟性」这一抽象性质，不是沉浸世界的名称。

entries.definition: The adjective behind reality; it contrasts with what is simulated.
entries.definitionCN: reality 背后的形容词，与模拟之物相对。

entries.definition: An artistic aim to show things as they are, which is not the same as making a world.
entries.definitionCN: 力求按本来面目呈现的艺术主张，与造一个世界不同。

entries.definition: Digital content laid over the live view rather than replacing it.
entries.definitionCN: 把数字内容叠加在实时画面上，而不是取代它。

entries.definition: A blend in which real and generated objects share one space and interact.
entries.definitionCN: 真实与生成之物共处一个空间并相互作用的混合。

entries.definition: An imitation of a system, often on a flat screen and not entered bodily.
entries.definitionCN: 对系统的模仿，常在平面屏幕上，不以身体进入。

entries.definition: A persistent shared online world, broader than one headset experience.
entries.definitionCN: 持续存在的共享网络世界，比单次头显体验更广。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real Latin roots, the real dated history and real technical phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用真实拉丁词根、真实可考年代与真实技术搭配。

normal.en: Virtual comes from Latin virtus 'power', so the phrase claims a world that is effective without being physical.
normal.cn: virtual 来自拉丁 virtus「力量」，因此这个短语主张一个有效却非实体的世界。

normal.en: Reality comes from Latin res 'thing', so the second word insists that this is a world, not a picture.
normal.cn: reality 来自拉丁 res「事物」，因此第二个词坚持这是一个世界，不是一幅画。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the uses: headset, training, game, experience, exposure therapy.
normal.cn: 固定说法标出用法：头显、训练、游戏、体验、暴露疗法。

normal.en: The abbreviation VR is used in shops and research papers alike.
normal.cn: 缩写 VR 在商店与研究论文里同样通用。

normal.en: The phrase was popularised in 1987 and reached consumers in the 2010s.
normal.cn: 这个短语在一九八七年流行，并在二十一世纪一十年代进入消费者市场。

abstract.en: A headset is a doorway; the world behind it has no floor you can fall through.
abstract.cn: 头显是一道门，门后的世界没有能摔下去的地板。

abstract.en: The body stays in the room while the eyes travel.
abstract.cn: 身体留在房间里，眼睛却出门远行。

abstract.en: When the effect is strong enough, the absence of the place stops mattering.
abstract.cn: 当效果足够强，地点的不存在就不再要紧。

examples.en: Virtual reality made it possible to rehearse the surgery before the patient arrived.
examples.cn: 虚拟现实让医生能在病人到来之前演练这台手术。

examples.en: The school uses virtual reality to show students places they cannot visit.
examples.cn: 学校用虚拟现实给学生展示他们去不了的地方。

examples.en: He spent the afternoon in virtual reality, building a house no one could live in.
examples.cn: 他一下午都泡在虚拟现实里，造一栋没人能住的房子。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「虚拟 + 现实」——眼睛进了另一个世界，身体还坐在原地

root: virtual 源自晚期拉丁 virtualis「有力量的」；reality 源自拉丁 realis「事物的」，更早为 res「事物」。该短语二十世纪三十年代见于法语，英语由拉尼尔于一九八七年推广；最早英语书面用例来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses follow one entered world: a generated environment, an industry, a headset experience, a training ground, a shared social space, an art form, a therapy, a fictional setting, and finally a false reality that replaces the real one.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项跟着同一个可进入的世界：生成的环境、一个产业、头显体验、训练场、共享社交空间、艺术形式、治疗场景、虚构设定，最后是取代真实世界的虚假现实。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a headset opens onto a market one can walk through while the body stays in the room.
core.cn: 核心意象：头显打开一座可以走动的市场，身体却留在房间里。

branches.en: THE WORLD AND THE DOOR: a generated place exists, and a display close to the eyes lets the body enter it.
branches.cn: 世界与门：一个生成的地点存在，贴近双眼的显示器让身体进入。

branches.en: THE INDUSTRY: the phrase names the hardware, software and companies around the world.
branches.cn: 产业：这个说法命名围绕该世界的硬件、软件与公司。

branches.en: THE REHEARSAL AND THE CURE: dangerous tasks and feared places are met safely inside the generated world.
branches.cn: 演练与疗愈：危险任务与恐惧场所在生成世界里被安全地面对。

branches.en: THE SHARED AND THE MADE: several people meet as avatars, and artists build spaces to walk inside.
branches.cn: 共享与创作：若干人以化身相见，艺术家搭建可走入的空间。

branches.en: THE STORY AND THE SUBSTITUTE: fiction uses the world as a setting, and advertisement uses it to replace the real one.
branches.cn: 故事与替代品：虚构把它当设定，广告用它取代真实。

intro.en: Virtual reality is a two-word term built from Late Latin virtualis and Latin realis.
intro.cn: virtual reality 是由晚期拉丁 virtualis 与拉丁 realis 构成的双词术语。

latinIntro.en: Latin virtus gives virtualis; Latin res gives realis; English joins the two adjectives and later makes them a fixed phrase.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 virtus 衍生 virtualis，拉丁 res 衍生 realis；英语把两个形容词连起来，后来固定成短语。

items.example: The first element of the phrase.
The second element insists on a world.
items.exampleCN: 第二部分坚持这是一个世界。

items.example: The root behind reality.
English shortened the Latin adjective.
items.exampleCN: 英语缩短了那个拉丁形容词。

items.example: English built the noun on realis.
items.exampleCN: 英语在 realis 上造出名词。

items.example: The abbreviation carries the phrase into daily use.
items.exampleCN: 缩写把短语带入日常使用。

items.meaning: a person who works in virtual reality
items.example: The suffix names the practitioner.
It builds reality and virtuality.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 reality 与 virtuality。

definition_zh: 增强现实；把数字内容实时叠加到实景画面上的技术；叠加后的观看体验
definition_en: a technology that lays computer-generated content over a live view of the real world
core_image: 一面断墙前举起平板，屏幕上沿着残存的石缝补出当年的拱顶与彩绘
scene: 导览员举起平板，镜头里的断墙上方自动叠出它当年的完整样貌。Augmented reality restored the missing roof on the screen.
sceneCN: 这里指把数字内容叠加到实时画面上（第 1 个义项：在实景上叠加数字信息）；句意为增强现实在屏幕上补出了缺失的屋顶。图中可辨识物件：平板、断墙、叠加线框、护栏。

pos.zh: 增强现实；实景叠加数字内容的技术

senses.title: Digital content over a live view
senses.definition: computer-generated images, text or sound laid over what the camera or eye sees in real time
senses.definitionCN: 计算机生成的图像、文字或声音实时叠加在镜头或眼睛所见之上
senses.example: The app uses augmented reality to label the machine parts.
senses.exampleCN: 这个应用用增强现实给机器零件加标注。
senses.why: Augmented says the real view is kept and added to, while virtual reality replaces it altogether.
senses.whyCN: 「增强」表示真实视图被保留并加以增补，而虚拟现实把它整个替换。

senses.title: The technology and industry
senses.definition: the hardware, software and companies that build overlays on live views
senses.definitionCN: 在实景视图上构建叠加层的硬件、软件与公司
senses.example: Augmented reality is moving from phones into glasses.
senses.exampleCN: 增强现实正从手机转向眼镜。
senses.why: Once a technique has a name, the businesses around it take the same name.
senses.whyCN: 当一种技术有了名字，围绕它的生意也用同一个名字。

senses.title: An app or a game
senses.definition: a program that places characters or objects into the camera view of a device
senses.definitionCN: 把角色或物件放进设备镜头画面的程序
senses.example: The game's augmented reality mode sends players into the square.
senses.exampleCN: 这款游戏的增强现实模式把玩家送进广场。
senses.why: The consumer form of the technique is a piece of software you point at the street.
senses.whyCN: 这项技术的消费者形态，是一个可以对着街道举起来的软件。

senses.title: Retail try-on
senses.definition: the placing of a product image on a customer's body or room through a camera
senses.definitionCN: 通过镜头把产品图像放到顾客身上或房间里
senses.example: The furniture shop added augmented reality so buyers could see a chair at home.
senses.exampleCN: 家具店加入增强现实，让买家能把椅子看到家里。
senses.why: The overlay answers a practical question: how would this look here, before it is bought.
senses.whyCN: 叠加层回答一个实际问题：买之前，这东西放在这里会是什么样。

senses.title: Surgical and industrial guidance
senses.definition: the projection of scans, measurements or instructions onto the field a professional is working in
senses.definitionCN: 把扫描、测量或指示投射到专业人员正在操作的现场
senses.example: Surgeons used augmented reality to see the vessel under the skin.
senses.exampleCN: 外科医生用增强现实看见皮下的血管。
senses.why: When the overlay sits on the patient or the pipe, hidden structure becomes visible where it is needed.
senses.whyCN: 当叠加层落在病人或管道上，隐藏的结构就在需要的地方变得可见。

senses.title: Education and museums
senses.definition: the use of overlays to show what is absent, ruined or invisible at a site
senses.definitionCN: 用叠加层在现场展示缺失、残毁或不可见之物
senses.example: The museum's augmented reality rebuilt the fallen wall for visitors.
senses.exampleCN: 博物馆的增强现实为参观者重建了倒塌的墙。
senses.why: The added layer is a memory attached to a real place, which is the gentlest use of the technology.
senses.whyCN: 被加上的一层是附在真实地点上的记忆，这是这项技术最温和的用法。

senses.title: Headsets and glasses
senses.definition: wearable see-through displays that add images to the wearer's ordinary field of view
senses.definitionCN: 在佩戴者平常视野中增添图像的可透视穿戴显示设备
senses.example: The new augmented reality glasses weigh less than a phone.
senses.exampleCN: 新的增强现实眼镜比一部手机还轻。
senses.why: The hardware branch names the device by what it adds, not by what it shows.
senses.whyCN: 硬件这一支以「增加什么」而非「显示什么」来命名设备。

senses.title: Mediated perception
senses.definition: a way of seeing in which what is present and what is added can no longer be easily separated
senses.definitionCN: 一种看见的方式，其中在场之物与添加之物已不易分开
senses.example: Critics describe social media as augmented reality for the ego.
senses.exampleCN: 批评者把社交媒体描述为给自我用的增强现实。
senses.why: The concept sense is the phrase at its widest: every screen adds a layer to what we call real.
senses.whyCN: 概念义是这个短语最宽的一层：每一块屏幕都给我们所谓的真实加上一层。

intro.en: Augmented reality joins augmented, from Latin augmentare 'to increase' and augere 'to grow', with reality, from Latin realis 'of a thing'. The term is generally attributed to Boeing researcher Tom Caudell around 1990; the exact first written use is source uncertain.
intro.cn: augmented reality 由 augmented（拉丁 augmentare「增加」、augere「生长」）与 reality（拉丁 realis「事物的」）组合。该术语一般认为由波音研究员汤姆·考德尔约一九九〇年提出；最早的书面用例来源不确定。

items.en: Latin augere meant to grow or increase, and gave augment, author and auction through related paths.
items.cn: 拉丁 augere 指生长或增加，经相关路径衍生 augment、author 与 auction。

items.en: Augmentare meant to make larger or to add to, and English augment keeps that plain sense of adding.
items.cn: augmentare 指使变大或增添，英语 augment 保留了「添加」这一直白意思。

items.en: Latin realis meant of a thing, from res 'thing', and reality names what is actually there.
items.cn: 拉丁 realis 指属于某物的，源自 res「事物」；reality 命名实际存在之物。

items.en: Boeing researcher Tom Caudell is generally credited with the term around 1990 for overlays that guided factory workers; the first written instance is source uncertain.
items.cn: 一般认为波音研究员汤姆·考德尔约一九九〇年为指导工人的叠加显示提出该术语；最早的书面实例来源不确定。

items.en: The 1990s saw overlays on assembly lines and in military displays, where instructions could sit on the object itself.
items.cn: 二十世纪九十年代，叠加层出现在装配线与军用显示器上，指示可以直接落在物件上。

items.en: Smartphones in the 2010s brought the technique to the public, and see-through glasses later moved it from the hand to the face.
items.cn: 二十一世纪一十年代的智能手机把这项技术带给大众，可透视眼镜后来把它从手上移到眼前。

note.en: The first group looks or sounds like augmented reality; the second group names neighbouring ideas in the same field.
note.cn: 第一组在形音上与「augmented reality」相近；第二组是同一领域里意思相邻的其他说法。

entries.definition: The verb meaning to add to or increase something.
entries.definitionCN: 指增加或增补某物的动词。

entries.definition: The noun for an addition or the act of adding.
entries.definitionCN: 表示增添或增添行为的名称。

entries.definition: The participle used in the phrase, meaning increased by an added layer.
entries.definitionCN: 短语中使用的分词，意为被添加的一层所增强。

entries.definition: The second element, naming the real world that is added to.
entries.definitionCN: 第二部分，命名被添加的真实世界。

entries.definition: A reasoned case or a quarrel; it looks close but comes from a different Latin verb.
entries.definitionCN: 论证或争吵；形近，却来自另一个拉丁动词。

entries.definition: A generated world that replaces the real view instead of adding to it.
entries.definitionCN: 取代而非增补真实视图的生成世界。

entries.definition: A space where real and generated objects interact rather than merely overlap.
entries.definitionCN: 真实与生成之物相互作用、而非仅叠加的空间。

entries.definition: A layer placed on top of another image.
entries.definitionCN: 放在另一图像之上的一层。

entries.definition: The process by which a device or medium stands between a person and the world.
entries.definitionCN: 设备或媒介挡在人与世界之间的过程。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real Latin growth word, the real dated history and real product phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用真实拉丁「增长」词、真实可考年代与真实产品搭配。

normal.en: Augere is Latin for grow, so augmented reality is reality with something grown onto it.
normal.cn: augere 是拉丁语「生长」，因此增强现实就是长出了一层的现实。

normal.en: The family runs augment, augmentation, augmented and the fixed phrase augmented reality.
normal.cn: 同族词有 augment、augmentation、augmented 与固定短语 augmented reality。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the uses: app, glasses, display, navigation, try-on.
normal.cn: 固定说法标出用法：应用、眼镜、显示、导航、试穿。

normal.en: The abbreviation AR is common in shops, schools and research.
normal.cn: 缩写 AR 在商店、学校与研究中通用。

normal.en: Virtual reality replaces the view; augmented reality keeps it and adds a layer.
normal.cn: 虚拟现实替换视图；增强现实保留视图并加一层。

abstract.en: The added layer sits on the object like a note stuck to it.
abstract.cn: 添加的那一层像一张便签贴在物件上。

abstract.en: The real wall remains; only the missing roof is drawn in.
abstract.cn: 真实的墙还在，只把缺失的屋顶画了上去。

abstract.en: When the layer is good enough, the eye stops asking which part is drawn.
abstract.cn: 当这一层足够好，眼睛就不再追问哪部分是被画出来的。

examples.en: Augmented reality turned the empty square into a guide to its own history.
examples.cn: 增强现实把空荡的广场变成了它自身历史的向导。

examples.en: The app uses augmented reality to show how the sofa would fit the room.
examples.cn: 这个应用用增强现实展示沙发如何放进房间。

examples.en: Engineers wore augmented reality glasses while repairing the turbine.
examples.cn: 工程师修理涡轮时戴着增强现实眼镜。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「增强 + 现实」——现实没被换掉，只被加上一层看得见的信息

root: augmented 来自拉丁 augere「生长、增加」，经 augmentare「使增大」；reality 来自拉丁 realis「事物的」、res「事物」。术语一般认为由波音的考德尔约一九九〇年提出，最早书面用例来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one added layer: a live view with digital content, an industry, an app, a try-on, a surgical guide, a museum reconstruction, a pair of glasses, and a mediated way of seeing.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项跟着同一层添加物：带数字内容的实时视图、一个产业、一个应用、一次试穿、一次手术引导、一次博物馆重建、一副眼镜，以及一种被中介的观看方式。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a tablet held before a broken wall redraws the missing roof exactly where it stood.
core.cn: 核心意象：一面断墙前举起平板，缺失的屋顶被画回它原来的位置。

branches.en: THE LAYER AND THE GLASS: content is laid over the live view, first on a held screen and later on the face.
branches.cn: 层与眼镜：内容叠加在实时视图上，先是在举起的屏幕上，后来在眼前。

branches.en: THE TRADE AND THE TOY: the technique becomes an industry and a game you point at the street.
branches.cn: 行业与玩物：技术变成产业，也变成对着街道举起的游戏。

branches.en: THE PRACTICAL QUESTION: will this chair look right here, asked before the purchase.
branches.cn: 实际问题：这把椅子放在这里好看吗，在购买之前就问。

branches.en: THE HIDDEN AND THE LOST: a vessel under the skin and a roof that fell are both drawn back into place.
branches.cn: 隐藏与失去：皮下的血管与倒塌的屋顶都被画回原位。

branches.en: THE WIDEST SENSE: every screen adds a layer to what we agree to call real.
branches.cn: 最宽的一层：每一块屏幕都给我们公认的真实加上一层。

intro.en: Augmented reality joins the Latin growth word augere with the Latin thing word res.
intro.cn: augmented reality 把拉丁「生长」词 augere 与拉丁「事物」词 res 连在一起。

latinIntro.en: Latin augere gives augmentare and English augment; Latin res gives realis and English reality; English joins the participles into a fixed term.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 augere 衍生 augmentare 与英语 augment；拉丁 res 衍生 realis 与英语 reality；英语把两个分词连成固定术语。
