definition_zh: 云计算；通过互联网按需获取计算、存储与软件服务的模式；提供这类服务的产业
definition_en: the delivery of computing services, including processing power, storage and software, over the internet on demand
core_image: 远处机房的指示灯一排排亮着，用户桌上只有一块薄屏幕和一根网线
scene: 学校的机房不再购买成排的服务器，而是按用量向远处租算力和存储。Cloud computing moved the department's servers off campus.
sceneCN: 这里指通过互联网按需获取计算资源（第 1 个义项：通过网络按需使用计算资源）；句意为云计算把这个系的服务器搬出了校园。图中可辨识物件：机柜、网络线、账单、远程屏幕。

pos.zh: 云计算；按需网络计算服务

senses.title: Computing bought as a service
senses.definition: the use of remote computing power, storage and software through a network instead of owning the equipment
senses.definitionCN: 通过网络使用远程算力、存储与软件，而不必自购设备
senses.example: Cloud computing let the start-up open without buying a single server.
senses.exampleCN: 云计算让这家初创公司一台服务器都不买就开张了。
senses.why: Computing became something you rent from a distance, which is the core of the phrase.
senses.whyCN: 计算变成可以从远处租来的东西，这是这个短语的核心。

senses.title: The industry and business model
senses.definition: the companies and billing models that sell computing by subscription or by use
senses.definitionCN: 以订阅或按用量出售计算能力的公司与计费模式
senses.example: Cloud computing is now a larger business than the hardware it replaced.
senses.exampleCN: 云计算如今比它所取代的硬件生意更大。
senses.why: A method of supply becomes a market, and the phrase names the market as well as the method.
senses.whyCN: 一种供给方式变成市场，这个短语既指方式也指市场。

senses.title: Remote services taken together
senses.definition: the whole set of remote services, including servers, databases, storage and software, offered over a network
senses.definitionCN: 通过网络提供的服务器、数据库、存储与软件等一整套远程服务
senses.example: The team moved its archive into cloud computing last spring.
senses.exampleCN: 团队去年春天把档案搬进了云计算。
senses.why: Users group many rented services under one familiar name, even though the services differ.
senses.whyCN: 用户把许多租来的服务归在一个熟悉的名称下，尽管这些服务并不相同。

senses.title: The public cloud
senses.definition: shared remote infrastructure that many customers use at once through a provider
senses.definitionCN: 由提供商运营、许多客户同时使用的共享远程基础设施
senses.example: Public cloud computing keeps costs low for small teams.
senses.exampleCN: 公有云计算让小团队的成本保持很低。
senses.why: The word cloud suggests a shared sky, and the public branch is exactly that: many users, one provider.
senses.whyCN: 云这个词暗示一片共享的天空，公有这一支正是如此：许多用户，一个提供商。

senses.title: The private cloud
senses.definition: remote-style computing built for one organization, either on its own site or isolated by a provider
senses.definitionCN: 为一个组织单独搭建、位于自有场地或由提供商隔离的类远程计算
senses.example: The bank runs private cloud computing behind its own walls.
senses.exampleCN: 银行在自己的墙内运行私有云计算。
senses.why: Even a single owner can keep the cloud's shape while excluding everyone else.
senses.whyCN: 即使只有一个所有者，也能保留云的形态而把其他人排除在外。

senses.title: Hybrid and multi-cloud
senses.definition: the use of several clouds, public and private, joined into one arrangement
senses.definitionCN: 把公有云与私有云等多个云连成一套安排
senses.example: Hybrid cloud computing lets the old system stay while new work runs elsewhere.
senses.exampleCN: 混合云计算让旧系统留下，新工作跑在别处。
senses.why: Once computing is rented, a company can rent from several landlords at once.
senses.whyCN: 一旦计算可以租，公司就能同时向几个房东租。

senses.title: Computing as a utility
senses.definition: a model in which computing is drawn from a network like electricity, paying for what is used
senses.definitionCN: 一种像用电一样从网络取用计算、按用量付费的模式
senses.example: Cloud computing treats processing power as a utility rather than a possession.
senses.exampleCN: 云计算把算力当作公用事业，而不是一项财产。
senses.why: The oldest industrial metaphor in the phrase is the utility: the wall socket matters, not the power station.
senses.whyCN: 这个短语里最古老的工业比喻是公用事业：重要的是墙上的插座，不是发电厂。

senses.title: The name from network diagrams
senses.definition: the use of a cloud shape in diagrams to stand for the internet, which gave the service its name
senses.definitionCN: 网络图中用云形代表互联网，这项服务由此得名
senses.example: The cloud in cloud computing began as a drawing of the unknown network.
senses.exampleCN: 云计算里的「云」最初只是对未知网络的画法。
senses.why: Engineers drew a cloud when they did not want to show the network's insides, and the drawing became the word.
senses.whyCN: 工程师不想画出网络内部时，就画一朵云，这朵云后来变成了词。

intro.en: Cloud computing joins cloud, from Old English clud 'rock, hill, cloud', and computing, from Latin computare 'to count'. The cloud symbol for a network goes back to engineering diagrams, and the term was used in the 1990s and popularised in 2006; the first use is source uncertain.
intro.cn: cloud computing 由 cloud（古英语 clud「岩石、山丘、云」）与 computing（拉丁 computare「计算」）组合。用云形代表网络源自工程图，术语在二十世纪九十年代已出现，并于二〇〇六年流行；最早用例来源不确定。

items.en: Old English clud first meant a rock or a hill, then a mass in the sky; the weather sense is the one English kept.
items.cn: 古英语 clud 最初指岩石或山丘，后指天空中的团块；英语保留的是天气那一义。

items.en: Network engineers drew a cloud to stand for the parts of a network they did not need to show, and the shape became a symbol for the internet.
items.cn: 网络工程师画一朵云代表无需展示的网络内部，这个形状后来成为互联网的符号。

items.en: Latin computare meant to count or reckon together, and gives compute, computer and computing.
items.cn: 拉丁 computare 指一起计数或核算，衍生 compute、computer 与 computing。

items.en: The phrase appeared in the 1990s in industry documents and early web services, though the first written use is source uncertain.
items.cn: 这个短语在二十世纪九十年代见于行业文件与早期网络服务，但最早书面用例来源不确定。

items.en: Large providers began selling computing as a metered service in 2006, and the phrase entered ordinary business speech.
items.cn: 二〇〇六年，大型提供商开始按用量出售计算，这个短语进入日常商业语言。

items.en: The idea that computing should be drawn from a network like electricity shaped the public cloud, billing and the language of the field.
items.cn: 计算应像电一样从网络取用的想法，塑造了公有云、计费方式与这一领域的语言。

note.en: The first group looks or sounds like cloud computing; the second group names neighbouring ideas in the same field.
note.cn: 第一组在形音上与「cloud computing」相近；第二组是同一领域里意思相邻的其他说法。

entries.definition: The first element, first a mass in the sky and then a diagram symbol for a network.
entries.definitionCN: 第一部分，最初指天上的云，后指网络的图示符号。

entries.definition: The second element, naming the activity of calculating and running machines.
entries.definitionCN: 第二部分，命名计算与运行机器的活动。

entries.definition: The verb behind computing, meaning to calculate.
entries.definitionCN: computing 背后的动词，意为计算。

entries.definition: Full of clouds in the weather sense; it has nothing to do with networks.
entries.definitionCN: 天气意义上的多云，与网络无关。

entries.definition: Power or influence; it sounds close but comes from a different source.
entries.definitionCN: 权力或影响力；读音相近，来源不同。

entries.definition: Computing sold like a metered utility, the model behind much of the cloud.
entries.definitionCN: 像计量公用事业一样出售计算，是云背后的模式。

entries.definition: Pooling many separate machines to work on one large job.
entries.definitionCN: 把许多分散机器汇合起来处理一项大任务。

entries.definition: Processing data near where it is produced instead of in a distant centre.
entries.definitionCN: 在数据产生处附近处理，而非在遥远的数据中心。

entries.definition: Software rented by subscription over a network rather than installed.
entries.definitionCN: 软件经网络按订阅租用，而非本地安装。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real Old English cloud, the real Latin count word and real service phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用真实的古英语「云」、真实拉丁「计算」词与真实服务搭配。

normal.en: Old English clud meant a hill or a mass, and the weather cloud later became the diagram symbol for a network.
normal.cn: 古英语 clud 指山丘或团块，天气的云后来成为网络的图示符号。

normal.en: Computing comes from Latin computare, to count together.
normal.cn: computing 来自拉丁 computare，意为一起计算。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the branches: public cloud, private cloud, hybrid cloud, cloud storage.
normal.cn: 固定说法标出各支：公有云、私有云、混合云、云存储。

normal.en: The phrase was used in the 1990s and became common business speech after 2006.
normal.cn: 这个短语在二十世纪九十年代已使用，二〇〇六年之后成为常见商业用语。

normal.en: The utility model compares computing to electricity drawn from a socket.
normal.cn: 公用事业模式把计算比作从插座取电。

abstract.en: The cloud is a rented sky: someone else owns the lightning.
abstract.cn: 云是一片租来的天空，闪电归别人所有。

abstract.en: You see a socket and a bill; the power station stays out of sight.
abstract.cn: 你看见插座和账单，发电厂留在视野之外。

abstract.en: The name began as a drawing of what the engineer chose not to show.
abstract.cn: 这个名字最初只是工程师选择不画出来的东西。

examples.en: Cloud computing allowed the newspaper to survive a sudden surge in readers.
examples.cn: 云计算让这家报纸挺过了读者突然激增的冲击。

examples.en: The hospital keeps patient records in cloud computing but encrypts them end to end.
examples.cn: 医院把病人记录放在云计算中，但做端到端加密。

examples.en: Before cloud computing, a new project began with a purchase order for servers.
examples.cn: 在云计算之前，新项目是从一张服务器采购单开始的。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「云 + 计算」——算力飘在远处，插座留在此地

root: cloud 源自西日耳曼语、古英语 clud「岩石、山丘、云」；computing 源自拉丁 computare「计算」。云形作为网络符号来自工程图；术语九十年代已见，二〇〇六年起流行，最早用例来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one rented sky: computing as a service, an industry, a bundle of remote services, the public cloud, the private cloud, hybrid arrangements, the utility model, and the diagram that named it.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项跟着同一片租来的天空：作为服务的计算、一个产业、一整套远程服务、公有云、私有云、混合安排、公用事业模式，以及给它命名的图示。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: rows of lights in a distant machine room, while the desk holds only a thin screen and a cable.
core.cn: 核心意象：远处机房里成排的指示灯亮着，桌上只有一块薄屏幕和一根网线。

branches.en: THE RENTED POWER: computing is drawn from a distance and paid for as it is used.
branches.cn: 租来的算力：计算从远处取用，用多少付多少。

branches.en: THE MARKET AND THE BUNDLE: the method becomes an industry, and many remote services are grouped under one name.
branches.cn: 市场与打包：方式变成产业，许多远程服务归在一个名下。

branches.en: THE PUBLIC SKY: many customers share one provider's infrastructure.
branches.cn: 公共的天空：许多客户共享一个提供商的基础设施。

branches.en: THE WALLED AND THE MIXED: one owner can keep the cloud's shape, and several clouds can be joined.
branches.cn: 围起来与混合：一个所有者可保留云的形态，几个云也可连成一套。

branches.en: THE UTILITY AND THE DRAWING: computing is taken like electricity, and the name began as a cloud drawn over the network.
branches.cn: 公用事业与图示：计算像电一样被取用，而名字始于一朵画在网络上的云。

intro.en: Cloud computing joins the Old English word for cloud with the Latin word for counting.
intro.cn: cloud computing 把古英语的「云」与拉丁语的「计算」连在一起。

latinIntro.en: Old English clud gives cloud; Latin computare gives compute and computing; English joins them into a fixed technical phrase.
latinIntro.cn: 古英语 clud 衍生 cloud；拉丁 computare 衍生 compute 与 computing；英语把它们连成固定技术短语。

items.example: The weather sense became the network symbol.
items.exampleCN: 天气义后来成为网络符号。

items.meaning: a mass in the sky; a network symbol
items.example: English kept both senses.
The root of the second element.
English shortened the Latin verb.
The suffix names the work.
The agent suffix names the machine.
The diminutive marks a smaller scale.
items.exampleCN: 指小后缀标出更小尺度。

items.example: It builds computing and processing.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 computing 与 processing 等词。

definition_zh: 贮藏；仓储；存放空间；存储（数据）；储能；冷藏；存储容量；保管费
definition_en: the keeping of goods or information in a place until they are needed, or the space and equipment used for this
core_image: 港口仓库里，集装箱按到货日期码成几层，等待装船
scene: 港口仓库里，集装箱按到货日期码成几层，等待装船。The port expanded its storage before the harvest season.
sceneCN: 这里指货物在仓库中的存放（第 1 个义项：把货物收存起来）；句意为港口在收获季前扩建了仓储。图中可辨识物件：集装箱、货架、叉车、码头。

pos.zh: 贮藏；仓储；存储；存放空间；保管费

senses.title: Keeping goods in a warehouse
senses.definition: the keeping of goods in a building or place until they are sold, moved or needed
senses.definitionCN: 把货物存放在建筑物或场所中，直到被出售、运走或需要时
senses.example: The port expanded its storage before the harvest season.
senses.exampleCN: 港口在收获季前扩建了仓储。
senses.why: The noun of store first names the act of laying goods by, and the warehouse is that act given walls.
senses.whyCN: 这个词的名词形式最初命名「把货物收起来」这个动作，仓库就是给这个动作加上墙壁。

senses.title: Space that can be rented
senses.definition: room or facilities let out for keeping goods, often charged by volume or by month
senses.definitionCN: 按体积或按月计费、供人存放货物的空间或设施
senses.example: The shop rents storage behind the station.
senses.exampleCN: 这家店在车站后面租了仓库。
senses.why: Once keeping goods became a service, the place itself could be sold, and the word named the space.
senses.whyCN: 当存放货物变成一种服务，场所本身就可以出售，这个词于是也指空间。

senses.title: Data storage
senses.definition: the keeping of digital information on disks, tapes or remote systems
senses.definitionCN: 把数字信息保存在磁盘、磁带或远程系统上
senses.example: The archive needs storage for another ten years of records.
senses.exampleCN: 档案馆还需要能再存十年记录的存储。
senses.why: The old verb of laying things by was applied to information, which is kept without being touched.
senses.whyCN: 古老的「把东西收起来」被用到信息上，信息被保存却无需触碰。

senses.title: Storage capacity
senses.definition: the amount of data or goods that a device or place can hold
senses.definitionCN: 设备或场所能容纳的数据量或货物量
senses.example: The phone's storage is full after the update.
senses.exampleCN: 更新之后手机的存储空间满了。
senses.why: Capacity is the measure of the container, so the word shifts from the act to the room available.
senses.whyCN: 容量是对容器的量度，这个词于是从动作转到可用空间。

senses.title: Energy storage
senses.definition: the holding of electrical or thermal energy until it is needed
senses.definitionCN: 把电能或热能保存到需要时再释放
senses.example: The grid added battery storage to absorb midday solar power.
senses.exampleCN: 电网增加了电池储能，以吸收正午的太阳能。
senses.why: Electricity can now be laid by like grain, which is the oldest sense applied to a new substance.
senses.whyCN: 电如今也能像谷物一样被收起来，这是最古老的意思用在新物质上。

senses.title: Cold storage
senses.definition: the keeping of food or biological material at low temperature to preserve it
senses.definitionCN: 在低温下保存食物或生物材料以延长其可用期
senses.example: The vaccine was moved to cold storage at once.
senses.exampleCN: 疫苗立刻被转进冷藏。
senses.why: Preservation by cold is only a special case of keeping, with temperature added as a tool.
senses.whyCN: 用低温保存只是「收存」的一个特例，温度成了工具。

senses.title: Water storage
senses.definition: the holding of water in a reservoir, tank or aquifer until it is used
senses.definitionCN: 把水蓄存在水库、水箱或含水层中直到使用
senses.example: The city built storage for two months of dry weather.
senses.exampleCN: 这座城市修建了可应付两个月干旱的蓄水设施。
senses.why: Water is the oldest thing a community stores, and the reservoir is its warehouse.
senses.whyCN: 水是一个群体最古老要储存的东西，水库就是它的仓库。

senses.title: Cloud storage
senses.definition: the keeping of data on remote servers reached through a network
senses.definitionCN: 把数据保存在通过网络访问的远程服务器上
senses.example: The lab moved its images to cloud storage.
senses.exampleCN: 实验室把图像搬到了云存储。
senses.why: The warehouse loses its walls and becomes someone else's machine room, but the act is unchanged.
senses.whyCN: 仓库失去了墙壁，变成别人的机房，但那个动作没有变。

senses.title: A charge for keeping
senses.definition: a fee charged for keeping goods in a place for a period
senses.definitionCN: 为在某处保存货物一段时间而收取的费用
senses.example: The buyer refused to pay storage after thirty days.
senses.exampleCN: 买家拒绝支付三十天之后的保管费。
senses.why: If keeping is a service, it can be billed, and the word moves from the thing kept to the price of keeping it.
senses.whyCN: 如果收存是一种服务，它就可以计费，这个词于是从事物转到保管的价钱。

intro.en: Storage is store plus the noun suffix -age. Store came from Old French estorer, from Latin instaurare 'to renew, restore, furnish'. The warehouse and data senses both come from the plain act of laying something by.
intro.cn: storage 是 store 加名词后缀 -age。store 来自古法语 estorer，上溯拉丁 instaurare「更新、恢复、置备」。仓储义与数据义都出自「把东西收起来」这个直白动作。

items.en: Latin instaurare meant to renew, restore or set up, and it is generally accepted as the source behind the French and English words for storing.
items.cn: 拉丁 instaurare 指更新、恢复或置备，一般认为它是法语与英语中「储存」一词背后的来源。

items.en: Old French estorer meant to supply, provide or keep, and it carried the Latin verb into everyday trade.
items.cn: 古法语 estorer 指供给、置备或保存，把这个拉丁动词带进日常交易。

items.en: Middle English store named a supply laid by and the place where it was kept, and the verb followed the noun.
items.cn: 中古英语 store 指置备的储备以及存放它的地方，动词随后跟上。

items.en: The noun suffix -age, from Latin -aticum through French, names a mass, a place or an activity, which is how storage names both keeping and the space for it.
items.cn: 名词后缀 -age 经法语来自拉丁 -aticum，命名集合、场所或活动，storage 因此既指保存也指保存空间。

items.en: In the nineteenth century warehouses became a paid service, and storage came to mean rented space as much as the goods in it.
items.cn: 十九世纪仓库成为收费服务，storage 逐渐既指租用空间，也指其中的货物。

items.en: From the mid-twentieth century the word was applied to punched cards, tapes and disks, and later to cloud systems.
items.cn: 二十世纪中期起，这个词被用于穿孔卡、磁带与磁盘，后来又用于云系统。

note.en: The first group looks or sounds like storage; the second group names neighbouring ideas in the same field.
note.cn: 第一组在形音上与「storage」相近；第二组是同一领域里意思相邻的其他说法。

entries.definition: The noun and verb behind storage, naming a supply or the act of keeping.
entries.definitionCN: storage 背后的名词与动词，指储备或保存动作。

entries.definition: The past participle used as an adjective for goods or data already kept.
entries.definitionCN: 过去分词作形容词，指已保存的货物或数据。

entries.definition: A room for keeping supplies, built with the same word plus room.
entries.definitionCN: 存放物资的房间，由同一个词加 room 构成。

entries.definition: A building for storing goods, the older compound for a warehouse.
entries.definitionCN: 存放货物的建筑，是仓库的较早复合说法。

entries.definition: The noun of the act and the space, formed with -age.
entries.definitionCN: 由 -age 构成的、指动作与空间的名词。

entries.definition: The business of keeping goods in a large building, closer to trade than to computing.
entries.definitionCN: 在大建筑中存放货物的行业，更近商业而非计算。

entries.definition: The amount a container can hold, which storage often measures.
entries.definitionCN: 容器的容纳量，storage 常以它计量。

entries.definition: The part of a computer that holds data temporarily while it is in use.
entries.definitionCN: 计算机中在使用时临时保存数据的部分。

entries.definition: A collection kept for the long term, together with the place that holds it.
entries.definitionCN: 长期保存的集合，以及存放它的地方。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real Latin restore word, the real suffix and real commercial phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用真实的拉丁「置备」词、真实后缀与真实商业搭配。

normal.en: The noun suffix -age turns the act of storing into storage, both the keeping and the space.
normal.cn: 名词后缀 -age 把「储存」这个动作变成 storage，既指保存也指空间。

normal.en: The family runs store, stored, storing, storeroom and storehouse.
normal.cn: 同族词有 store、stored、storing、storeroom 与 storehouse。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the branches: storage space, data storage, storage capacity, cold storage.
normal.cn: 固定说法标出各支：仓储空间、数据存储、存储容量、冷藏。

normal.en: A warehouse is storage with walls; a data centre is storage with racks.
normal.cn: 仓库是有墙壁的存储，数据中心是有机架的存储。

normal.en: Cold storage adds temperature to the old act of keeping.
normal.cn: 冷藏给古老的收存动作加上温度。

abstract.en: Storage is a promise that the thing will still be there tomorrow.
abstract.cn: 存储是一句承诺：那件东西明天还在。

abstract.en: The room is measured in shelves, the disk in bytes, and both are the same patience.
abstract.cn: 房间以货架计量，磁盘以字节计量，两者是同一种耐心。

abstract.en: What is stored is not gone; it is only out of sight.
abstract.cn: 被储存的东西并未消失，只是离开了视野。

examples.en: The farm built a new storage shed for the grain harvest.
examples.cn: 农场为收粮建了一座新的储藏棚。

examples.en: Storage on the laptop ran out during the video edit.
examples.cn: 剪辑视频时笔记本的存储用完了。

examples.en: Battery storage lets the solar plant sell power after sunset.
examples.cn: 电池储能让太阳能电站在日落后仍能售电。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「思道瑞吉」——把东西收到库房里，心里就踏实：贮藏、存储

root: store 来自古法语 estorer，上溯拉丁 instaurare「更新、置备」；加名词后缀 -age 构成 storage。仓储义与数据义都从「把东西收起来」发展而来。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses follow one act of keeping: goods in a warehouse, rented space, digital data, capacity, energy, cold preservation, water, remote cloud data, and the fee for keeping.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项跟着同一个「收存」动作：仓库里的货物、租用的空间、数字数据、容量、能量、冷藏、水、远程云端数据，以及保管费。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: containers stacked by arrival date in a port warehouse, waiting for a ship.
core.cn: 核心意象：港口仓库里，集装箱按到货日期码成几层，等待装船。

branches.en: THE WAREHOUSE: goods are kept, and the space that holds them can be rented.
branches.cn: 仓库：货物被保存，容纳它们的空间可以出租。

branches.en: THE DATA AND THE MEASURE: information is kept, and the container is measured in bytes.
branches.cn: 数据与量度：信息被保存，容器以字节计量。

branches.en: THE SUBSTANCES KEPT: electricity, food and water are all laid by against a later need.
branches.cn: 被保存的物质：电、食物与水都被收起来以备后用。

branches.en: THE WALLS DISAPPEAR: cloud storage keeps data in someone else's machine room.
branches.cn: 墙壁消失：云存储把数据保存在别人的机房。

branches.en: THE FEE: what is kept can be billed, so the word also names the price of keeping.
branches.cn: 费用：被保存的东西可以计费，因此这个词也命名保管的价钱。

intro.en: Storage is the noun of store plus the suffix -age, with store from Latin instaurare.
intro.cn: storage 是 store 加后缀 -age 构成的名词，store 上溯拉丁 instaurare。

latinIntro.en: Latin instaurare gives Old French estorer, which gives English store; English adds -age to name the act and the place.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 instaurare 衍生古法语 estorer，再衍生英语 store；英语加 -age 命名动作与场所。

items.example: The source behind the French verb.
French carried the verb into trade.
items.exampleCN: 法语把这个动词带进交易。

items.example: English kept both the thing and the act.
items.exampleCN: 英语保留了事物与动作两面。

items.meaning: the act or place of keeping
items.example: The suffix names both keeping and space.
The compound gives the keeping a room.
items.exampleCN: 复合词给收存一间屋子。

items.example: The older compound for a warehouse.
The participle describes the goods.
The form names the ongoing act.
items.exampleCN: 该形式命名进行中的动作。

items.meaning: suffix of mass, place or activity
items.meaningCN: 表示集合、场所或活动的后缀
items.example: It builds storage and mileage.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 storage 与 mileage 等词。

definition_zh: 处理器；中央处理器；对原料、数据或信号进行加工的设备；处理事务的人或机构
definition_en: a device or person that processes something, especially the central unit of a computer that carries out instructions
core_image: 主板中央一块指甲盖大小的芯片，四周的线路像放射状的河道向它汇拢
scene: 笔记本主板中央有一块指甲盖大小的芯片，所有指令都在它这里排队执行。A faster processor cut the export time in half.
sceneCN: 这里指执行指令的中央处理芯片（第 1 个义项：中央处理器）；句意为更快的处理器把导出时间缩短了一半。图中可辨识物件：主板、芯片、散热片、风扇。

pos.zh: 处理器；加工设备；处理者

collocations.zh: 文字处理软件；文字处理机

senses.title: The central unit of a computer
senses.definition: the part of a computer that reads and carries out instructions, often called the central processing unit
senses.definitionCN: 计算机中读取并执行指令的部件，常称中央处理器
senses.example: A faster processor cut the export time in half.
senses.exampleCN: 更快的处理器把导出时间减半。
senses.why: The agent suffix -or names the thing that performs the process, and the chip is the worker inside the machine.
senses.whyCN: 施动后缀 -or 命名执行过程的那个东西，芯片就是机器内部的劳动者。

senses.title: A kitchen machine
senses.definition: an electric machine with blades that chops, slices or mixes food
senses.definitionCN: 带刀片、可切碎、切片或搅拌食物的电动机械
senses.example: She put the nuts in the food processor.
senses.exampleCN: 她把坚果放进了食品加工机。
senses.why: The word left the office for the kitchen because the machine performs the same act on a different material.
senses.whyCN: 这个词从办公室走进厨房，因为机器只是换了一种材料执行同样的动作。

senses.title: A word processor
senses.definition: software, or an older dedicated machine, for writing and editing text
senses.definitionCN: 用于写作与编辑文本的软件或较早的专用机器
senses.example: The old word processor still loads faster than the new suite.
senses.exampleCN: 那台旧文字处理机载入仍比新套件快。
senses.why: Text is the material here, and the machine processes it into a finished page.
senses.whyCN: 这里的材料是文字，机器把它加工成一页成稿。

senses.title: A data processor
senses.definition: a person or system that turns raw data into organised information
senses.definitionCN: 把原始数据变成有条理信息的人或系统
senses.example: The agency acts as a data processor for three hospitals.
senses.exampleCN: 这家机构为三家医院充当数据处理者。
senses.why: In law and business the processor is whoever acts on data supplied by another, so the agent suffix matters.
senses.whyCN: 在法律与商业中，处理者是替他人处理所提供数据的一方，施动后缀在这里很关键。

senses.title: A signal processor
senses.definition: a circuit or program that filters, transforms or analyses electronic signals
senses.definitionCN: 对电子信号进行滤波、变换或分析的电路或程序
senses.example: The hearing aid's signal processor removes the background hum.
senses.exampleCN: 助听器的信号处理器去掉了背景嗡嗡声。
senses.why: Sound and radio are materials too, and the same worker word covers them.
senses.whyCN: 声音与无线电也是材料，同一个「加工者」词同样覆盖它们。

senses.title: A payment processor
senses.definition: a company that moves card and bank payments between buyers, sellers and banks
senses.definitionCN: 在买方、卖方与银行之间传递银行卡与银行支付的机构
senses.example: The payment processor rejected the card before the order was sent.
senses.exampleCN: 支付处理商在订单发出前拒收了这张卡。
senses.why: Money is processed as a stream of authorisations, so the company is named by the act it performs.
senses.whyCN: 钱被当作一连串授权来处理，公司因此以它执行的动作命名。

senses.title: An image processor
senses.definition: a chip or program that turns sensor data into a usable picture
senses.definitionCN: 把传感器数据变成可用图像的芯片或程序
senses.example: The camera's image processor reduces noise in low light.
senses.exampleCN: 相机的图像处理器减少弱光下的噪点。
senses.why: Light becomes numbers, and the processor is the stage where numbers become an image.
senses.whyCN: 光变成数字，处理器是数字变回图像的工位。

senses.title: A machine that treats materials
senses.definition: an industrial device that treats a material by heat, pressure or chemical action
senses.definitionCN: 通过加热、加压或化学作用处理材料的工业设备
senses.example: The plant added a processor for the waste oil.
senses.exampleCN: 工厂增加了一台废油处理设备。
senses.why: This is the factory sense at its plainest: raw material goes in, treated material comes out.
senses.whyCN: 这是最朴素的工厂义：原料进去，处理过的材料出来。

intro.en: Processor is process plus the agent suffix -or. Process comes from Latin processus 'advance, progress', from procedere 'to go forward', built on pro- 'forward' and cedere 'to go'. The computing sense arose in the mid-twentieth century.
intro.cn: processor 是 process 加施动后缀 -or。process 来自拉丁 processus「前进、进展」，上溯 procedere「向前走」，由 pro-「向前」与 cedere「走」构成。计算义在二十世纪中期出现。

items.en: Latin procedere meant to go forward or come forth, built from pro- 'forward' and cedere 'to go, yield'.
items.cn: 拉丁 procedere 指向前走或出来，由 pro-「向前」与 cedere「走、让」构成。

items.en: Processus named an advance, a course or a progression, and English process kept both the forward movement and the set of steps.
items.cn: processus 指前进、进程或推移，英语 process 既保留向前运动，也保留一套步骤。

items.en: The Latin-derived suffix -or names the doer of an action, so a processor is the thing or person that carries the process out.
items.cn: 源自拉丁语的施动后缀 -or 命名动作的执行者，因此处理器就是执行该过程的东西或人。

items.en: From the 1950s the central unit that fetched and executed instructions was called a processor, later the central processing unit.
items.cn: 二十世纪五十年代起，取指令并执行指令的中央单元被称为处理器，后来称中央处理器。

items.en: Food processors and word processors took the same name in the twentieth century because each machine performs a process on a material.
items.cn: 食品加工机与文字处理机在二十世纪用了同一个名字，因为每台机器都在对某种材料执行加工。

items.en: Payment processors and data processors extend the word to organisations that carry out a defined procedure for others.
items.cn: 支付处理商与数据处理者把这个词扩展到替他人执行既定流程的机构。

note.en: The first group looks or sounds like processor; the second group names neighbouring ideas in the same field.
note.cn: 第一组在形音上与「processor」相近；第二组是同一领域里意思相邻的其他说法。

entries.definition: The noun and verb behind the agent; it names the course of steps rather than the doer.
entries.definitionCN: 施动者背后的名词与动词，指步骤过程而非执行者。

entries.definition: The activity itself, formed with -ing rather than the agent suffix.
entries.definitionCN: 这项活动本身，用 -ing 而非施动后缀构成。

entries.definition: The participle describing material that has been through the process.
entries.definitionCN: 描述已经过加工的材料的分词。

entries.definition: A line of people moving forward, from the same Latin verb but not the same sense.
entries.definitionCN: 向前行进的人群，同出那个拉丁动词，但意思不同。

entries.definition: A person who came before another in an office; the ending looks similar but the base differs.
entries.definitionCN: 职位上前任的人；词尾相似，词基不同。

entries.definition: The full name of the main chip, of which processor is the short form.
entries.definitionCN: 主芯片的全称，处理器是其简称。

entries.definition: A device that directs a process rather than carrying out the arithmetic itself.
entries.definitionCN: 指挥过程而非亲自执行运算的装置。

entries.definition: A person or routine that deals with something, often more general than processor.
entries.definitionCN: 处理某事的人或例程，通常比处理器更泛。

entries.definition: Any device that performs work, the broadest word in this field.
entries.definitionCN: 执行工作的任何装置，是这一领域最宽泛的词。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real Latin forward verb, the real agent suffix and real product phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用真实的拉丁「向前」动词、真实施动后缀与真实产品搭配。

normal.en: Process comes from Latin procedere, to go forward, and -or marks the thing that does it.
normal.cn: process 来自拉丁 procedere「向前走」，-or 标出执行它的东西。

normal.en: The family runs process, processing, processed, processor and multiprocessor.
normal.cn: 同族词有 process、processing、processed、processor 与 multiprocessor。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the uses: central processor, word processor, food processor, payment processor.
normal.cn: 固定说法标出用法：中央处理器、文字处理机、食品加工机、支付处理商。

normal.en: The central processing unit is the full name; processor is the short one.
normal.cn: 中央处理器是全称，processor 是简称。

normal.en: A kitchen machine and a chip share the name because both act on a material.
normal.cn: 厨房机器与芯片共用一个名字，因为两者都对某种材料施加动作。

abstract.en: A processor is a worker that never sees the whole task, only the next instruction.
abstract.cn: 处理器是一个从不见全貌、只看见下一条指令的工人。

abstract.en: The chip is small because its work is narrow: fetch, decode, execute, repeat.
abstract.cn: 芯片之所以小，是因为它的活很窄：取指、译码、执行，再来一遍。

abstract.en: Every screen you see has passed through some processor's hands.
abstract.cn: 你看见的每一块屏幕，都经过某个处理器之手。

examples.en: The new processor runs cooler than the one it replaced.
examples.cn: 新处理器比它所替换的那颗运行得更凉。

examples.en: A payment processor sits between the shop and the bank.
examples.cn: 支付处理商坐在商店与银行之间。

examples.en: The food processor saves her an hour of chopping.
examples.cn: 食品加工机替她省下一小时的切菜时间。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「破塞色」——把一堆活硬塞进去、破开来做，就是处理器

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one worker: the central chip, a kitchen blade, a text tool, a data handler, a signal circuit, a payment firm, an image engine, and an industrial treater.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项跟着同一个执行者：中央芯片、厨房刀片、文字工具、数据经手方、信号电路、支付公司、图像引擎，以及工业处理设备。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a fingernail-sized chip at the centre of a board, lines converging on it like rivers.
core.cn: 核心意象：主板中央一块指甲盖大小的芯片，线路像河道一样向它汇拢。

branches.en: THE DOER OF THE STEPS: a chip, a text tool and a data handler all carry out a defined procedure.
branches.cn: 步骤的执行者：芯片、文字工具与数据经手方都在执行既定流程。

branches.en: THE MATERIAL WORKERS: food and light are both put through a machine that turns them into something usable.
branches.cn: 材料加工者：食物与光都被送进机器，变成可用的东西。

branches.en: THE SIGNAL WORKER: a circuit filters a stream that is neither food nor text.
branches.cn: 信号加工者：电路过滤一股既非食物也非文字的流。

branches.en: THE MONEY WORKER: authorisations are passed from buyer to seller to bank.
branches.cn: 金钱加工者：授权从买方传到卖方再到银行。

branches.en: THE INDUSTRIAL WORKER: waste oil goes in, treated material comes out.
branches.cn: 工业加工者：废油进去，处理过的材料出来。

intro.en: Processor is process plus the Latin agent suffix -or, with process from procedere.
intro.cn: processor 是 process 加拉丁施动后缀 -or，process 来自 procedere。

latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 procedere 衍生 processus 与英语 process；拉丁施动后缀 -or 构成 processor，即过程的执行者。

definition_zh: 处理；加工；对数据、信号、材料或申请按步骤进行的一系列操作
definition_en: the act of carrying out a series of operations on data, signals, materials or requests
core_image: 实验室里一排样本瓶沿着传送带依次经过过滤、加热与读数三站
scene: 实验室把一批水样送进仪器，机器按顺序完成过滤、加热和读数。The processing of the samples took most of the afternoon.
sceneCN: 这里指按步骤对材料或数据作一系列操作（第 1 个义项：按步骤进行操作的过程）；句意为样品的处理占了下午大半时间。图中可辨识物件：水样瓶、仪器、流程卡、记录表。

senses.title: Carrying out a series of steps
senses.definition: the carrying out of a series of operations on materials, data or requests to bring them to a usable state
senses.definitionCN: 对材料、数据或请求执行一系列操作、使其达到可用状态的过程
senses.example: The processing of the samples took most of the afternoon.
senses.exampleCN: 样品的处理占了下午大半时间。
senses.why: Processing is the activity noun of process, and the core sense is a series of steps applied to a material.
senses.whyCN: 这个词由动词「进行」加活动词尾构成，核心义就是对材料施加一系列步骤。

senses.title: Food processing
senses.definition: the treatment of food by heat, pressure, drying or chemicals to preserve or transform it
senses.definitionCN: 用加热、加压、干燥或化学方法保存或改变食物
senses.example: Food processing removes water so the fruit keeps longer.
senses.exampleCN: 食品加工去除水分，使水果保存更久。
senses.why: Food is the oldest material put through a process, and the word keeps that kitchen and factory sense.
senses.whyCN: 食物是最早被按步骤处理的材料，这个词保留了厨房与工厂的那层意思。

senses.title: Signal processing
senses.definition: the analysis and transformation of electronic signals to remove noise or extract information
senses.definitionCN: 对电子信号进行分析与变换，以去噪或提取信息
senses.example: Signal processing cleaned the recording of the bird song.
senses.exampleCN: 信号处理把鸟鸣录音里的杂音清理干净。
senses.why: A signal is a stream, and processing is what turns a noisy stream into a readable one.
senses.whyCN: 信号是一股流，处理就是把嘈杂的流变成可读的东西。

senses.title: Natural language processing
senses.definition: the use of computers to analyse and generate human language
senses.definitionCN: 用计算机分析与生成人类语言
senses.example: Natural language processing now sorts the complaints by topic.
senses.exampleCN: 自然语言处理如今按主题给投诉分类。
senses.why: Language becomes data, and the same step-by-step treatment is applied to words.
senses.whyCN: 语言变成数据，同一套按步骤的处理被施加到词上。

senses.title: Payment processing
senses.definition: the authorisation and settlement of card or bank payments between parties
senses.definitionCN: 在各方之间完成银行卡或银行支付的授权与结算
senses.example: Payment processing failed twice before the order went through.
senses.exampleCN: 支付处理失败了两次，订单才通过。
senses.why: Money moves as a series of checks, and the checks are the processing.
senses.whyCN: 钱以一连串核验的方式移动，这些核验就是处理。

senses.title: Image processing
senses.definition: the manipulation of digital pictures to improve, measure or recognise their content
senses.definitionCN: 对数字图像进行操纵，以改善、测量或识别其内容
senses.example: Image processing sharpened the blurred plate number.
senses.exampleCN: 图像处理让模糊的车牌变清晰了。
senses.why: A picture is a grid of numbers, and processing is the arithmetic performed on that grid.
senses.whyCN: 图像是一格格数字，处理就是对那一格格数字做运算。

senses.title: Industrial material processing
senses.definition: the treatment of raw materials by physical or chemical means in manufacturing
senses.definitionCN: 在制造中用物理或化学手段处理原料
senses.example: The plant's processing of ore uses less water than it did before.
senses.exampleCN: 这家工厂的矿石加工比过去用水更少。
senses.why: This is the factory floor again: raw material enters, treated material leaves.
senses.whyCN: 这又回到工厂车间：原料进去，处理过的材料出来。

senses.title: Handling an application
senses.definition: the official steps by which a request, claim or document is examined and decided
senses.definitionCN: 审查并决定请求、索赔或文件的官方步骤
senses.example: Visa processing can take six weeks in summer.
senses.exampleCN: 夏季签证处理可能需要六周。
senses.why: A request is treated as a material that must pass through stages before it is finished.
senses.whyCN: 一项请求被当作必须经过若干阶段才完成的材料。

senses.title: Central processing
senses.definition: the execution of instructions by the main unit of a computer
senses.definitionCN: 由计算机主单元执行指令
senses.example: Central processing is fast, but the disk is still the slow part.
senses.exampleCN: 中央处理很快，但磁盘仍是慢的那一环。
senses.why: The computing sense narrows the act to the chip, where the steps happen in order at great speed.
senses.whyCN: 计算义把这动作收窄到芯片上，步骤在那里以极快速度依次发生。

intro.en: Processing is process plus -ing. Process came from Latin processus 'advance', from procedere 'to go forward' (pro- 'forward' plus cedere 'to go'). It shares its root with processor, but names the activity rather than the agent.
intro.cn: processing 是 process 加 -ing。process 来自拉丁 processus「前进」，上溯 procedere「向前走」（pro-「向前」加 cedere「走」）。它与 processor 同根，但命名的是活动而非执行者。

items.en: Latin procedere meant to go forward, built from pro- 'forward' and cedere 'to go, yield'.
items.cn: 拉丁 procedere 指向前走，由 pro-「向前」与 cedere「走、让」构成。

items.en: Processus named an advance or a course of events, and English process kept the sense of ordered steps.
items.cn: processus 指前进或事件进程，英语 process 保留「有序步骤」之意。

items.en: The ending -ing turns the verb into a noun of activity, so processing is the carrying out of the steps, not the thing that carries them.
items.cn: 词尾 -ing 把动词变成活动名词，因此 processing 指执行步骤，而非执行步骤的东西。

items.en: In the nineteenth century processing named the treatment of food and raw materials in factories.
items.cn: 十九世纪，processing 指工厂中对食物与原料的加工。

items.en: From the mid-twentieth century the word was applied to data, signals and images, where the material is invisible.
items.cn: 二十世纪中期起，这个词被用于数据、信号与图像，材料变成不可见之物。

items.en: Processor names the doer with -or and processing names the doing with -ing, so the pair keeps the two sides of one Latin verb.
items.cn: processor 用 -or 命名执行者，processing 用 -ing 命名执行，两者保留同一个拉丁动词的两面。

note.en: The first group looks or sounds like processing; the second group names neighbouring ideas in the same field.
note.cn: 第一组在形音上与「processing」相近；第二组是同一领域里意思相邻的其他说法。

entries.definition: The base noun and verb, naming the course of steps without the activity ending.
entries.definitionCN: 基础名词与动词，指步骤过程，不带活动词尾。

entries.definition: The doer of the process, formed with the agent suffix; it is not the activity.
entries.definitionCN: 过程的执行者，由施动后缀构成，不是活动本身。

entries.definition: The participle describing material that has already gone through the steps.
entries.definitionCN: 描述已走过这些步骤的材料的分词。

entries.definition: A forward-moving line of people, from the same verb but a different branch.
entries.definitionCN: 向前行进的队伍，同出那个动词但属另一支。

entries.definition: An action or a legal case, closer to the forward-movement sense of the Latin verb.
entries.definitionCN: 行动或法律程序，更近拉丁动词「向前」那一义。

entries.definition: The application of a process to a material or a patient, often in one round.
entries.definitionCN: 对材料或病人施加一次处理，常指一轮。

entries.definition: The managing or moving of something, with less emphasis on ordered steps.
entries.definitionCN: 对某物的管理或搬运，较少强调有序步骤。

entries.definition: The carrying out of calculations, a narrower kind of processing.
entries.definitionCN: 执行计算，是 processing 更窄的一种。

entries.definition: The removal of impurities or rough parts, one kind of material processing.
entries.definitionCN: 去除杂质或粗糙部分，是材料处理的一种。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real Latin forward verb, the real -ing suffix and real technical phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用真实的拉丁「向前」动词、真实 -ing 后缀与真实技术搭配。

normal.en: Process comes from Latin procedere, to go forward, and -ing names the activity rather than the doer.
normal.cn: process 来自拉丁 procedere「向前走」，-ing 命名活动而非执行者。

normal.en: Processor and processing share one root: the doer and the doing.
normal.cn: processor 与 processing 同根：执行者与执行。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the branches: data processing, signal processing, food processing, payment processing.
normal.cn: 固定说法标出各支：数据处理、信号处理、食品加工、支付处理。

normal.en: Natural language processing applies the same steps to words.
normal.cn: 自然语言处理把同样的步骤施加到词上。

normal.en: Image processing is arithmetic performed on a grid of numbers.
normal.cn: 图像处理是对一格格数字做运算。

abstract.en: Processing is a conveyor belt: each stage hands the thing to the next.
abstract.cn: 处理是一条传送带：每一站把东西交给下一站。

abstract.en: The material changes shape, but the order of steps is what makes it reliable.
abstract.cn: 材料改变形态，而可靠性来自步骤的顺序。

abstract.en: Nothing is finished until the last stage lets it go.
abstract.cn: 直到最后一站放手，东西才算完成。

examples.en: The processing of the visa took longer than the flight itself.
examples.cn: 签证的处理比飞行本身还久。

examples.en: Signal processing removed most of the wind noise from the recording.
examples.cn: 信号处理去掉了录音里的大部分风声。

examples.en: Food processing often adds salt, so the label must say so.
examples.cn: 食品加工常加盐，因此标签必须注明。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses follow one series of steps: data handled, food treated, signals cleaned, language analysed, payments settled, images sharpened, ore processed, applications examined, and instructions executed.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项跟着同一串步骤：数据处理、食物加工、信号清理、语言分析、支付结算、图像锐化、矿石处理、申请审查，以及指令执行。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: sample bottles moving along a belt through filtering, heating and reading.
core.cn: 核心意象：一排样本瓶沿传送带依次经过过滤、加热与读数三站。

branches.en: THE STEPPED ACT: data or instructions are taken through a fixed order of operations.
branches.cn: 按步骤的动作：数据或指令被带过一套固定顺序的操作。

branches.en: THE MATERIAL: food and ore are changed by heat, pressure or chemistry.
branches.cn: 材料：食物与矿石被加热、加压或化学作用改变。

branches.en: THE INVISIBLE MATERIAL: signals and images are streams and grids that are cleaned by arithmetic.
branches.cn: 不可见的材料：信号与图像是靠运算清理的流与网格。

branches.en: THE SYMBOLIC MATERIAL: words and applications are also put through ordered stages.
branches.cn: 符号材料：词与申请也要经过有序阶段。

branches.en: THE MONEY: authorisation and settlement are the processing of a payment.
branches.cn: 金钱：授权与结算就是一笔支付的处理。

definition_zh: 操作系统；管理计算机硬件与软件资源、为程序提供运行环境的系统软件
definition_en: the system software that manages a computer's hardware and software resources and provides services for programs
core_image: 一台刚开机的电脑屏幕上，语言、网络与账户三个选项依次排开，桌面还藏在后面
scene: 新买的电脑第一次开机，屏幕先让用户选语言、连网络，然后才进入桌面。The operating system manages the memory that every program asks for.
sceneCN: 这里指管理硬件与软件资源的系统软件（第 1 个义项：管理计算机资源的系统软件）；句意为操作系统管理每个程序申请的内存。图中可辨识物件：开机画面、桌面图标、内存条、设置窗口。

senses.title: The software that runs the machine
senses.definition: the system software that manages hardware, memory, files and processes and lets other programs run
senses.definitionCN: 管理硬件、内存、文件与进程、并让其他程序得以运行的系统软件
senses.example: The operating system manages the memory that every program asks for.
senses.exampleCN: 操作系统管理每个程序申请的内存。
senses.why: Operate names the running of a machine and system names an organised whole, so the phrase is the running whole.
senses.whyCN: 前一词命名机器的运行，后一词命名有组织的整体，因此这个短语就是「运行的整体」。

senses.title: A particular product
senses.definition: one named product that performs this role, sold in versions for different machines
senses.definitionCN: 执行这一角色的某个具名产品，按不同机器分版本出售
senses.example: The laptop ships with a different operating system.
senses.exampleCN: 这台笔记本预装了另一个操作系统。
senses.why: A common noun becomes a product name when several vendors sell their own version of the same role.
senses.whyCN: 当多家厂商各自出售同一角色的版本，普通名词就变成产品名。

senses.title: A mobile system
senses.definition: the system software of a phone or tablet, built for touch input and limited power
senses.definitionCN: 手机或平板的系统软件，为触控输入与有限电量而设计
senses.example: Most apps on the phone were written for its operating system.
senses.exampleCN: 手机上的多数应用是为它的操作系统写的。
senses.why: The same role moves to a smaller machine, and the phrase follows the device.
senses.whyCN: 同一角色搬到更小的机器，短语也跟着设备走。

senses.title: A server system
senses.definition: a system software build tuned for many users, long uptime and remote administration
senses.definitionCN: 为多用户、长时间运行与远程管理而调优的系统软件版本
senses.example: The server operating system was patched without a restart.
senses.exampleCN: 服务器操作系统在不重启的情况下打了补丁。
senses.why: The role stays the same, but the conditions of running change, so a separate branch appears.
senses.whyCN: 角色不变，运行条件变了，于是分出独立一支。

senses.title: An embedded or real-time system
senses.titleCN: 嵌入式或实时操作系统
senses.definition: a small system software build that must respond within fixed time limits, used inside devices
senses.definitionCN: 必须在固定时限内响应、装在设备内部的小型系统软件
senses.example: The car's operating system must react before the wheel turns.
senses.exampleCN: 汽车的操作系统必须在车轮转动前作出反应。
senses.why: When a machine cannot wait, the running whole is built to guarantee time, not to offer features.
senses.whyCN: 当机器不能等待，这个运行的整体就要保证时间，而不是提供功能。

senses.title: The platform for programs
senses.definition: the layer whose rules and services determine what other software can do
senses.definitionCN: 其规则与服务决定其他软件能做什么的那一层
senses.example: The game will not run on an older operating system.
senses.exampleCN: 这款游戏无法在较旧的操作系统上运行。
senses.why: Whoever controls the layer controls the ground on which other programs stand.
senses.whyCN: 谁控制这一层，谁就控制其他程序站立的地面。

senses.title: A layer in the stack
senses.definition: one layer between hardware and applications in a description of a computer's structure
senses.definitionCN: 在描述计算机结构时，位于硬件与应用之间的一层
senses.example: The diagram puts the operating system between the chip and the browser.
senses.exampleCN: 这张图把操作系统放在芯片与浏览器之间。
senses.why: The phrase can be abstracted into a layer, which is how computing textbooks use it.
senses.whyCN: 这个短语可以被抽象成一层，计算教材正是这样使用它。

senses.title: The legacy sense
senses.definition: the software that supervised jobs on early mainframes, the ancestor of the modern system
senses.definitionCN: 早期大型机上监督作业的软件，是现代系统的前身
senses.example: The museum keeps a tape from an early operating system.
senses.exampleCN: 博物馆保存着一盘早期操作系统的磁带。
senses.why: The role existed before the phrase was fixed, and the older machines show the same running whole in plainer form.
senses.whyCN: 这个角色在短语固定之前就已存在，旧机器以更朴素的形式展示同一个运行整体。

intro.en: Operating system joins operating, from Latin operari 'to work', from opus 'work', and system, from Greek systema 'organised whole', from syn- 'together' and histanai 'to set up'. The phrase became standard in computing around 1960; the exact first use is source uncertain.
intro.cn: operating system 由 operating（拉丁 operari「工作」，源自 opus「工作」）与 system（希腊 systema「有组织的整体」，源自 syn-「一起」与 histanai「设立」）组合。该短语约一九六〇年在计算领域成为标准说法；最早用例来源不确定。

items.en: Latin opus meant work, especially a piece of work or a task, and it underlies operate, operation and opera.
items.cn: 拉丁 opus 指工作，尤指一件作品或一项任务，是 operate、operation 与 opera 的基底。

items.en: Operari meant to work or to be at work, and English operate kept the sense of a machine doing its work.
items.cn: operari 指工作或正在工作，英语 operate 保留「机器做它的活」这一义。

items.en: Greek systema meant an organised whole made of parts, from syn- 'together' and histanai 'to set up'.
items.cn: 希腊 systema 指由各部分组成的有组织整体，源自 syn-「一起」与 histanai「设立」。

items.en: English system kept the Greek sense of a whole of connected parts, and later applied it to bodies, laws and machines.
items.cn: 英语 system 保留希腊语「相互连接的部分构成的整体」之义，后来用于身体、法律与机器。

items.en: Around 1960 the phrase operating system was used for software that supervised jobs and resources; earlier machines used other names.
items.cn: 约一九六〇年，operating system 被用来指监督作业与资源的软件；更早的机器用别的名称。

items.en: Personal computers in the 1980s turned the phrase into product names, and mobile and embedded systems extended it further.
items.cn: 二十世纪八十年代的个人电脑把这个短语变成产品名，移动与嵌入式系统又把它推得更远。

note.en: The first group looks or sounds like operating system; the second group names neighbouring ideas in the same field.
note.cn: 第一组在形音上与「operating system」相近；第二组是同一领域里意思相邻的其他说法。

entries.definition: The verb meaning to work or to control a machine.
entries.definitionCN: 指工作或操作机器的动词。

entries.definition: The act of running or a medical procedure, from the same work word.
entries.definitionCN: 运行行为或医疗手术，同出那个「工作」词。

entries.definition: A person who runs a machine, or a symbol that performs an action.
entries.definitionCN: 操作机器的人，或执行动作的符号。

entries.definition: In working order or ready for use, rather than related to an operating system.
entries.definitionCN: 处于可工作状态或可使用的，而非指操作系统。

entries.definition: An organised whole of parts, the second element of the phrase.
entries.definitionCN: 由各部分组成的有组织整体，短语的第二部分。

entries.definition: The core of a system that controls hardware and processes, smaller than the whole system.
entries.definitionCN: 控制硬件与进程的系统核心，比整个系统更小。

entries.definition: Software fixed into a device that runs before a full system starts.
entries.definitionCN: 固定在设备中、在完整系统启动前运行的软件。

entries.definition: The layer or environment on which other software is built.
entries.definitionCN: 其他软件建立其上的层或环境。

entries.definition: The environment in which a program executes, narrower than a whole system.
entries.definitionCN: 程序执行的环境，比整个系统更窄。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real Latin work word, the real Greek whole and real technical phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用真实拉丁「工作」词、真实希腊「整体」词与真实技术搭配。

normal.en: Operate comes from Latin operari, to work, and system comes from Greek systema, an organised whole.
normal.cn: operate 来自拉丁 operari「工作」，system 来自希腊 systema「有组织的整体」。

normal.en: The phrase names the software whose work is to keep the whole machine working.
normal.cn: 这个短语命名的是「以维持整台机器运转为工作」的软件。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the branches: mobile, desktop, server and real-time operating system.
normal.cn: 固定说法标出各支：移动、桌面、服务器与实时操作系统。

normal.en: The abbreviation OS is used in shops and code alike.
normal.cn: 缩写 OS 在商店与代码里同样通用。

normal.en: A kernel is the core; the operating system is the whole arrangement around it.
normal.cn: 内核是核心，操作系统是围绕它的整套安排。

abstract.en: It is the floor on which every other program stands.
abstract.cn: 它是其他所有程序站立的地板。

abstract.en: When the floor shakes, every program feels it.
abstract.cn: 地板一晃，每个程序都感觉得到。

abstract.en: The user sees icons; the system sees resources being handed out.
abstract.cn: 用户看见图标，系统看见资源被分发。

examples.en: The update fixed a flaw in the operating system's memory handling.
examples.cn: 这次更新修复了操作系统内存管理中的一个漏洞。

examples.en: Without an operating system, every program would have to drive the hardware itself.
examples.cn: 没有操作系统，每个程序都得自己驱动硬件。

examples.en: The phone's operating system decides which app may use the camera.
examples.cn: 手机的操作系统决定哪个应用可以使用摄像头。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「操作 + 系统」——替所有程序管机器的那套规矩

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one running whole: the software that manages the machine, a product, a mobile build, a server build, an embedded build, a platform, a layer in a diagram, and its mainframe ancestor.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项跟着同一个运行整体：管理机器的软件、一个产品、移动版本、服务器版本、嵌入式版本、一个平台、图中的一层，以及它的大型机前身。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a boot screen offering language, network and account, with the desktop still hidden behind it.
core.cn: 核心意象：开机画面依次给出语言、网络与账户，桌面还藏在后面。

branches.en: THE RUNNING WHOLE: software does the work of keeping the machine and its programs running.
branches.cn: 运行的整体：软件承担维持机器与程序运转的工作。

branches.en: THE BUILDS: the same role is sold as products and tuned for phones, servers and devices that cannot wait.
branches.cn: 各种版本：同一角色既作为产品出售，也为手机、服务器与不能等待的设备调优。

branches.en: THE GROUND: whoever owns the layer decides what other programs may do.
branches.cn: 地面：谁拥有这一层，谁就决定其他程序能做什么。

branches.en: THE DIAGRAM LAYER: textbooks place it between the chip and the application.
branches.cn: 图中的一层：教材把它放在芯片与应用之间。

branches.en: THE ANCESTOR: early mainframes already had software supervising jobs, before the phrase was fixed.
branches.cn: 前身：早期大型机已有监督作业的软件，那时短语尚未固定。

intro.en: Operating system joins the Latin work word opus through operari with the Greek whole word systema.
intro.cn: operating system 把经 operari 而来的拉丁「工作」词 opus 与希腊「整体」词 systema 连在一起。

latinIntro.en: Latin opus gives operari and English operate; Greek systema gives Latin systema and English system; English joins operating with system.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 opus 衍生 operari 与英语 operate；希腊 systema 衍生拉丁 systema 与英语 system；英语把 operating 与 system 连起来。

definition_zh: 应用软件；为最终用户完成具体任务而编写的程序；相对于系统软件的一类软件
definition_en: software written to help end users perform particular tasks, as opposed to the system software that runs the machine
core_image: 办公桌上并排摆着表格、邮件与绘图三个窗口，各做各的活
scene: 办公桌上，职员打开表格、邮件与绘图三套程序，各自完成不同的活。The company replaced its old application software with a browser-based suite.
sceneCN: 这里指供最终用户完成具体任务的程序（第 1 个义项：面向用户任务的软件）；句意为公司把旧的应用软件换成了一套浏览器端套件。图中可辨识物件：表格、邮件窗口、绘图工具、浏览器。

pos.zh: 应用软件；用户任务软件

senses.title: Programs for user tasks
senses.titleCN: 为用户任务编写的程序
senses.definition: software designed to help a person write, calculate, design, communicate or play
senses.definitionCN: 为帮助人写作、计算、设计、沟通或娱乐而设计的软件
senses.example: The company replaced its old application software with a browser-based suite.
senses.exampleCN: 公司把旧的应用软件换成了一套浏览器端套件。
senses.why: Application names the act of applying a tool to a task, and software names the program, so the phrase is a tool for a use.
senses.whyCN: 前一词命名把工具用于任务的动作，后一词命名程序，因此这个短语就是「为某种用途而设的工具」。

senses.title: A mobile app
senses.definition: a program for a phone or tablet, usually downloaded from a store and opened with a tap
senses.definitionCN: 为手机或平板编写、通常从商店下载并点开即用的程序
senses.example: The ticket lives in an application software package on her phone.
senses.exampleCN: 票就在她手机上的一个应用软件包里。
senses.why: The phrase shrinks to a single icon, and the short form app carries the everyday sense.
senses.whyCN: 这个短语缩成一个图标，短形「应用」承担日常义。

senses.title: A desktop application
senses.definition: a program installed on a personal computer and run in its own window
senses.definitionCN: 安装在个人电脑上、在自有窗口中运行的程序
senses.example: The designers still prefer desktop application software for large drawings.
senses.exampleCN: 设计师处理大幅图纸时仍偏爱桌面应用软件。
senses.why: The personal computer gave the tool a fixed home, and installation became part of the meaning.
senses.whyCN: 个人电脑给了工具一个固定的家，安装于是成为词义的一部分。

senses.title: An enterprise application
senses.definition: a large program or system that runs a company's records, money, staff or supply chain
senses.definitionCN: 运行公司记录、资金、人员或供应链的大型程序或系统
senses.example: The hospital bought enterprise application software for its accounts.
senses.exampleCN: 医院为账务购买了企业应用软件。
senses.why: When many users and rules are involved, the tool grows into an institution and the word grows with it.
senses.whyCN: 当涉及许多用户与规则，工具长成一套制度，这个词也随之长大。

senses.title: A suite of programs
senses.definition: a group of programs sold together and designed to work with one another
senses.definitionCN: 一组一起出售、设计上可相互配合的程序
senses.example: The office suite is application software, not part of the system.
senses.exampleCN: 办公套件属于应用软件，不是系统的一部分。
senses.why: Several tools in one box are still tools, and the phrase covers the bundle.
senses.whyCN: 几件工具装在一个盒子里仍是工具，这个短语覆盖整包。

senses.title: A web application
senses.definition: a program that runs in a browser and is used through a network rather than installed locally
senses.definitionCN: 在浏览器中运行、经网络使用而非本地安装的程序
senses.example: The accounts team moved to web application software last year.
senses.exampleCN: 账务团队去年转向了网页应用软件。
senses.why: The window no longer belongs to the machine; the tool is borrowed from a server.
senses.whyCN: 窗口不再属于本机，工具是从服务器借来的。

senses.title: The category opposed to system software
senses.titleCN: 与系统软件相对的一类
senses.definition: the class of software that serves users, as distinct from the system software that serves the machine
senses.definitionCN: 服务于用户的一类软件，区别于服务机器的系统软件
senses.example: A computer needs both system and application software to be useful.
senses.exampleCN: 一台电脑既需要系统软件也需要应用软件才能有用。
senses.why: The phrase exists mainly to draw a line: one layer runs the machine, the other puts it to use.
senses.whyCN: 这个短语主要用来划线：一层运行机器，另一层让机器派上用场。

senses.title: The work of building such programs
senses.definition: the industry and practice of designing, coding, testing and maintaining programs for users
senses.definitionCN: 为用户程序设计、编码、测试与维护的行业与实践
senses.example: She studied application software development after a degree in mathematics.
senses.exampleCN: 她读完数学学位后去学应用软件开发。
senses.why: Once a class of programs exists, the work of making them becomes a field with its own name.
senses.whyCN: 当一类程序存在，制造它们的工作就成了一个有名字的领域。

intro.en: Application software joins application, from Latin applicare 'to attach', built on ad- 'to' and plicare 'to fold', with software, a twentieth-century English compound of soft and ware. The phrase became common with personal computers; its exact first use is source uncertain.
intro.cn: application software 由 application（拉丁 applicare「贴上」，由 ad-「向」与 plicare「折」构成）与 software（二十世纪英语复合词，soft 加 ware）组合。该短语随个人电脑普及；最早用例来源不确定。

items.en: Latin plicare meant to fold, and it underlies apply, complicate, explicit and replicate.
items.cn: 拉丁 plicare 指折叠，是 apply、complicate、explicit 与 replicate 的基底。

items.en: Applicare meant to attach one thing to another, from ad- 'to' and plicare 'fold', and English apply kept the sense of putting a thing to a use.
items.cn: applicare 指把一物贴到另一物上，由 ad-「向」与 plicare「折」构成，英语 apply 保留「把某物用于某用途」。

items.en: English application named the act of applying and later a formal request, and in computing it named a use of the machine.
items.cn: 英语 application 指应用的行为，后来指正式申请；在计算领域指机器的一种用途。

items.en: The word software was coined in 1958 as a counterpart to hardware, using soft and ware to name programs rather than metal.
items.cn: software 于一九五八年作为 hardware 的对应词被造出，用 soft 与 ware 指程序而非金属。

items.en: From the late 1970s the phrase application software separated programs for users from the system that ran the machine.
items.cn: 二十世纪七十年代末起，这个短语把面向用户的程序与运行机器的系统分开。

items.en: Phones shortened the phrase to app, and browsers made web applications ordinary, so the class now covers installed and borrowed programs alike.
items.cn: 手机把短语缩成 app，浏览器让网页应用普及，这一类如今既包括本地安装也包括远程借用的程序。

note.en: The first group looks or sounds like application software; the second group names neighbouring ideas in the same field.
note.cn: 第一组在形音上与「application software」相近；第二组是同一领域里意思相邻的其他说法。

entries.definition: A use of something, or a formal request; the first element of the phrase.
entries.definitionCN: 某物的用途或正式申请，是短语的第一部分。

entries.definition: The verb meaning to put something to use or to make a request.
entries.definitionCN: 指把某物用于某处或提出请求的动词。

entries.definition: A person who makes a request, from the same verb but not the computing sense.
entries.definitionCN: 提出申请的人，同出那个动词，但非计算义。

entries.definition: Able to be applied or relevant, from the same folding root.
entries.definitionCN: 可应用或相关的，同出那个「折」词根。

entries.definition: A household machine, originally something attached to a use.
entries.definitionCN: 家用机器，原指附于某种用途之物。

entries.definition: Software that runs the machine, the class opposed to application software.
entries.definitionCN: 运行机器的软件，与应用软件相对的一类。

entries.definition: Any coded set of instructions, whether for users or for the machine.
entries.definitionCN: 任何编码的指令集，无论面向用户还是机器。

entries.definition: The short everyday form for a mobile application.
entries.definitionCN: 移动应用的日常简称。

entries.definition: A group of programs sold and used together.
entries.definitionCN: 一起出售与使用的一组程序。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real Latin folding verb, the real 1958 coinage and real product phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用真实拉丁「折」动词、真实一九五八年造词与真实产品搭配。

normal.en: Plicare is Latin for fold, so applicare is to fold one thing onto another, and application is putting a tool to a task.
normal.cn: plicare 是拉丁语「折」，因此 applicare 是把一物折贴到另一物上，application 就是把工具用于任务。

normal.en: Software was coined in 1958 as the counterpart of hardware.
normal.cn: software 于一九五八年作为 hardware 的对应词被造出。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the branches: desktop, enterprise, custom and web application software.
normal.cn: 固定说法标出各支：桌面、企业、定制与网页应用软件。

normal.en: The class is defined against system software: one serves the user, the other serves the machine.
normal.cn: 这一类是相对系统软件定义的：一个服务用户，一个服务机器。

normal.en: The short form app now names the mobile member of the class.
normal.cn: 短形 app 如今指这一类的移动成员。

abstract.en: Application software is a tool laid on a task, like a hand on a handle.
abstract.cn: 应用软件是放在任务上的工具，像手握上把手。

abstract.en: The system builds the room; the application decides what happens in it.
abstract.cn: 系统造出房间，应用决定房里发生什么。

abstract.en: Every icon on the desktop is a folded promise of some work being made easier.
abstract.cn: 桌面上的每个图标，都是一句「某件活会变容易」的折起的承诺。

examples.en: She installed application software for editing photographs.
examples.cn: 她安装了用于编辑照片的应用软件。

examples.en: Application software is updated far more often than the system beneath it.
examples.cn: 应用软件的更新远比它下面的系统频繁。

examples.en: The school teaches application software before it teaches programming.
examples.cn: 这所学校先教应用软件，再教编程。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「应用 + 软件」——为某件具体的活而设的程序

root: application 来自拉丁 applicare「贴上」，由 ad- 向 + plicare 折；software 是一九五八年为对应 hardware 造出的英语复合词。短语随个人电脑普及，最早用例来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one tool for a task: user programs, a mobile app, a desktop program, an enterprise system, a suite, a web app, the class opposed to system software, and the work of building them.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项跟着同一件「为任务而设的工具」：用户程序、移动应用、桌面程序、企业系统、套件、网页应用、与系统软件相对的一类，以及开发它们的工作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: three windows side by side on one desk, each doing a different piece of work.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张桌上并排三个窗口，各干各的一件活。

branches.en: THE TOOL AND THE LINE: software serves a user, and the phrase draws the line against system software.
branches.cn: 工具与界线：软件服务用户，这个短语划出与系统软件的界线。

branches.en: THE HOMES OF THE TOOL: a phone icon, a desktop window and a browser tab are three places the same tool lives.
branches.cn: 工具的住处：手机图标、桌面窗口与浏览器标签，是同一件工具的三个住处。

branches.en: THE ENTERPRISE: many users and rules make the tool into an institution.
branches.cn: 企业：许多用户与规则把工具变成一套制度。

branches.en: THE SUITE: several tools sold together are still tools.
branches.cn: 套件：一起出售的几件工具仍是工具。

branches.en: THE MAKING: designing, coding, testing and maintaining the tools becomes a field of work.
branches.cn: 制造：设计、编码、测试与维护这些工具，成为一项领域。

intro.en: Application software joins the Latin folding verb plicare through applicare with the English compound software.
intro.cn: application software 把经 applicare 而来的拉丁「折」动词 plicare 与英语复合词 software 连在一起。

latinIntro.en: Latin plicare gives applicare and English apply, application and appliance; English soft plus ware gives software; the two are joined into a fixed class name.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 plicare 衍生 applicare 与英语 apply、application、appliance；英语 soft 加 ware 构成 software；两者连成固定的类别名称。

definition_zh: 网络安全；保护计算机系统、网络与数据免受攻击、破坏或未经授权访问的实践与领域
definition_en: the practice and field of protecting computer systems, networks and data from attack, damage or unauthorised access
core_image: 银行内网的一块告警面板上，红色标记逐条亮起，值班人员一条条核对来源
scene: 银行内网每天收到大量试探登录，安全团队盯着告警面板逐个处置。Strong cybersecurity kept the bank's customer records out of the breach.
sceneCN: 这里指保护系统与网络免受攻击的整体工作（第 1 个义项：保护计算机系统与网络免受攻击）；句意为有力的网络安全防护让银行客户记录没有落入泄露事件。图中可辨识物件：告警面板、登录窗口、锁形图标、值班表。

pos.zh: 网络安全；网络空间安全

senses.title: Protecting systems and networks
senses.definition: the work of defending computers, networks and data against unauthorised access, disruption or theft
senses.definitionCN: 保护计算机、网络与数据，防止未经授权的访问、破坏或窃取
senses.example: Strong cybersecurity kept the bank's customer records out of the breach.
senses.exampleCN: 有力的网络安全防护让银行客户记录没有落入泄露事件。
senses.why: Cyber names the networked space and security names freedom from harm, so the word is protection inside that space.
senses.whyCN: 前缀命名联网空间，后一词命名免于伤害，因此这个词就是那个空间内部的保护。

senses.title: The industry and profession
senses.definition: the companies, teams and careers built around defending networks
senses.definitionCN: 围绕网络防御建立的公司、团队与职业
senses.example: The firm hired a cybersecurity team before the product launch.
senses.exampleCN: 公司在产品发布前雇了一支网络安全团队。
senses.why: A defensive practice becomes a trade once the threat is constant enough to pay for.
senses.whyCN: 当威胁持续到值得付费，防御做法就变成一门行业。

senses.title: Defensive measures
senses.definition: the specific controls used to protect a system, such as firewalls, patches and access rules
senses.definitionCN: 用于保护系统的具体控制手段，如防火墙、补丁与访问规则
senses.example: Poor cybersecurity left an old password on the server.
senses.exampleCN: 糟糕的网络安全措施让服务器上留着一个旧密码。
senses.why: The abstract field is made of concrete measures, and the same word covers both.
senses.whyCN: 抽象的领域由具体措施组成，同一个词兼指两者。

senses.title: Defence of an organization
senses.definition: the arrangements by which an institution protects its records, money and services
senses.definitionCN: 机构保护其记录、资金与服务的一整套安排
senses.example: The audit found gaps in the ministry's cybersecurity.
senses.exampleCN: 审计发现该部门的网络安全存在缺口。
senses.why: When the protected thing is an institution, the word names a management duty, not only a technology.
senses.whyCN: 当被保护的对象是机构，这个词命名的是一项管理职责，而不只是技术。

senses.title: National policy
senses.definition: the laws, agencies and strategies by which a state protects its networks and infrastructure
senses.definitionCN: 国家保护其网络与基础设施的法律、机构与战略
senses.example: The new law treats cybersecurity as part of public safety.
senses.exampleCN: 新法律把网络安全视为公共安全的一部分。
senses.why: Networks cross borders and carry public services, so defence rises from the firm to the state.
senses.whyCN: 网络跨越边界并承载公共服务，防御因此从企业上升到国家。

senses.title: Personal hygiene
senses.definition: the everyday habits by which an individual protects accounts, devices and data
senses.definitionCN: 个人保护账户、设备与数据的日常习惯
senses.example: Good cybersecurity starts with changing a reused password.
senses.exampleCN: 良好的网络安全从改掉重复使用的密码开始。
senses.why: The same defence shrinks to one person's habits, where most breaches actually begin.
senses.whyCN: 同一套防御缩到一个人的习惯上，而多数泄露正是从这里开始。

senses.title: An academic discipline
senses.definition: the study of attacks, defences and risk, taught as a subject with its own methods
senses.definitionCN: 研究攻击、防御与风险的学问，作为一门有自身方法的学科来教授
senses.example: The university added a degree in cybersecurity last year.
senses.exampleCN: 这所大学去年增设了网络安全学位。
senses.why: Once defence has methods and evidence, it can be taught and researched like any other field.
senses.whyCN: 当防御有了方法与证据，它就能像其他领域一样被教授与研究。

senses.title: The threat landscape
senses.definition: the changing set of attackers, methods and vulnerabilities that defenders must track
senses.definitionCN: 防御者必须跟踪的攻击者、手法与漏洞的变动集合
senses.example: Ransomware changed the cybersecurity picture for small clinics.
senses.exampleCN: 勒索软件改变了小诊所的网络安全格局。
senses.why: The word also names the problem, not only the answer, because defence is defined by what it faces.
senses.whyCN: 这个词也命名问题而不只是答案，因为防御由它所面对的东西来定义。

intro.en: Cybersecurity joins cyber-, from cybernetics, coined by Norbert Wiener in 1948 from Greek kybernetes 'steersman', with security, from Latin securitas and securus 'free from care'. The compound became common in the 1990s; the exact first use is source uncertain.
intro.cn: cybersecurity 由 cyber-（源自维纳一九四八年据希腊 kybernetes「舵手」造出的 cybernetics）与 security（拉丁 securitas、securus「无忧」）组合。该复合词在二十世纪九十年代普及；最早用例来源不确定。

items.en: Greek kybernetes meant a steersman or governor, the person who steers a ship and keeps it on course.
items.cn: 希腊 kybernetes 指舵手或掌舵者，即驾驶船只并使其保持航向的人。

items.en: Norbert Wiener used cybernetics for the study of control and communication in animals and machines, taking the Greek steering word.
items.cn: 维纳用 cybernetics 指对动物与机器中控制与通信的研究，取自那个希腊「掌舵」词。

items.en: From the 1960s cyber- was attached to spaces and activities that were networked, giving cyberspace, cybercrime and later cyberattack.
items.cn: 二十世纪六十年代起，cyber- 被加到联网的空间与活动上，造出网络空间、网络犯罪，后来又造出网络攻击。

items.en: Latin securus meant free from care, built from se- 'without' and cura 'care', and English secure and security come from it.
items.cn: 拉丁 securus 指无忧，由 se-「无」与 cura「忧虑」构成，英语 secure 与 security 由此而来。

items.en: Latin securitas named freedom from danger or care, and English security widened it to protection, guarantees and financial instruments.
items.cn: 拉丁 securitas 指免于危险或忧虑，英语 security 把它扩展到保护、担保与金融工具。

items.en: The two parts were joined in the 1990s as networks became central to business and government; the earliest written use is source uncertain.
items.cn: 两部分在二十世纪九十年代网络成为商业与政府核心时被连起来；最早书面用例来源不确定。

note.en: The first group looks or sounds like cybersecurity; the second group names neighbouring ideas in the same field.
note.cn: 第一组在形音上与「cybersecurity」相近；第二组是同一领域里意思相邻的其他说法。

entries.definition: A prefix or adjective meaning networked or computer-based.
entries.definitionCN: 表示联网或计算机化的前缀或形容词。

entries.definition: The imagined space of networks, built with the same steering prefix.
entries.definitionCN: 由网络构成的想象空间，同用那个「掌舵」前缀。

entries.definition: The study of control and communication, the source of the prefix.
entries.definitionCN: 研究控制与通信的学问，是该前缀的来源。

entries.definition: Protection from danger, the second element of the compound.
entries.definitionCN: 免于危险的保护，是复合词的第二部分。

entries.definition: Crime carried out through networks, the thing this field defends against.
entries.definitionCN: 经网络实施的犯罪，正是这一领域要防御的对象。

entries.definition: Protection of information wherever it is held, whether or not networked.
entries.definitionCN: 保护无论存于何处的信息，不论是否联网。

entries.definition: Protection of the links and traffic between machines.
entries.definitionCN: 保护机器之间的链路与流量。

entries.definition: The ability to keep working and recover after an attack, rather than only to prevent it.
entries.definitionCN: 遭攻击后仍能运作并恢复的能力，而不只是预防。

entries.definition: Active measures to detect and respond to attacks, often in a military or national setting.
entries.definitionCN: 侦测并回应攻击的主动措施，常用于军事或国家语境。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real Greek steering word, the real Latin care word and real policy phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用真实希腊「掌舵」词、真实拉丁「忧虑」词与真实政策搭配。

normal.en: Cybernetics comes from Greek kybernetes, a steersman, and Norbert Wiener coined it in 1948.
normal.cn: cybernetics 来自希腊 kybernetes「舵手」，由维纳于一九四八年造出。

normal.en: Security comes from Latin securus, free from care, built from se- 'without' and cura 'care'.
normal.cn: security 来自拉丁 securus「无忧」，由 se-「无」与 cura「忧虑」构成。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the branches: cybersecurity threat, policy, firm, awareness, framework.
normal.cn: 固定说法标出各支：网络安全威胁、政策、公司、意识、框架。

normal.en: A firewall, a patch and an access rule are all concrete members of the field.
normal.cn: 防火墙、补丁与访问规则都是这一领域的具体成员。

normal.en: The field is defined by what it defends against, so the threat landscape is part of it.
normal.cn: 这一领域由它所防御的东西来定义，因此威胁格局也是它的一部分。

abstract.en: Cybersecurity is a lock on a door that opens onto the whole world.
abstract.cn: 网络安全是装在一扇通向全世界的门上的锁。

abstract.en: The defenders must be right every day; the attacker needs one good night.
abstract.cn: 防御者每天都要做对，攻击者只需要一个好夜晚。

abstract.en: Most breaches begin with one small habit, which is why the field reaches down to individuals.
abstract.cn: 多数泄露始于一个小习惯，这就是这一领域延伸到个人的原因。

examples.en: The hospital increased its cybersecurity budget after a phishing attack.
examples.cn: 在一次钓鱼攻击后，医院增加了网络安全预算。

examples.en: Cybersecurity is now taught in schools as part of digital literacy.
examples.cn: 网络安全如今作为数字素养的一部分在学校教授。

examples.en: A single weak password can defeat years of cybersecurity.
examples.cn: 一个弱密码就能击穿多年的网络安全防护。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one defence inside a network: protecting systems, an industry, concrete measures, an institution's duty, national policy, personal habits, a discipline, and the threat landscape itself.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项跟着同一场网络空间里的防御：保护系统、一个产业、具体措施、机构职责、国家政策、个人习惯、一门学科，以及威胁格局本身。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a bank's warning panel lighting up row by row while an analyst checks each source.
core.cn: 核心意象：银行告警面板逐条亮起，分析员核对每一个来源。

branches.en: THE DEFENCE AND ITS MEASURES: abstract protection is made of firewalls, patches and rules.
branches.cn: 防御与措施：抽象的保护由防火墙、补丁与规则组成。

branches.en: THE TRADE AND THE SCHOOL: constant threat turns defence into a career and then into a taught discipline.
branches.cn: 行业与学堂：持续的威胁把防御变成职业，再变成被教授的学科。

branches.en: THE INSTITUTION AND THE STATE: a firm protects its records, and a state protects networks that carry public services.
branches.cn: 机构与国家：企业保护记录，国家保护承载公共服务的网络。

branches.en: THE PERSON: most breaches start with one habit, so the field reaches down to the individual.
branches.cn: 个人：多数泄露始于一个习惯，因此这一领域延伸到个人。

branches.en: THE PROBLEM: the changing set of attackers and weaknesses half-defines the defence.
branches.cn: 问题：不断变化的攻击者与弱点，反过来定义了防御的一半。
