definition_zh: 安全；保障；保护措施；治安保卫；担保；抵押品；证券；安全感；社会保障
definition_en: protection from danger, harm or loss, the measures taken to provide it, or something given as a guarantee
core_image: 演出入口处，一只只包被打开检查，队伍在金属门旁缓慢前移
scene: 演出开始前，入口处有人检查包袋、核对票面，队伍缓慢前移。Security checked every bag before the concert began.
sceneCN: 这里指维持现场安全的保卫工作与人员（第 2 个义项：保护人身与场所的措施）；句意为演出开始前安保检查了每个包。图中可辨识物件：检票口、包袋、金属探测门、排队线。

pos.zh: 安全；保障；保护措施；担保；证券

senses.title: Freedom from danger
senses.definition: the state of being safe from harm, loss or attack
senses.definitionCN: 免受伤害、损失或攻击的状态
senses.example: The children need a sense of security before they can learn.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子需要安全感才能学习。
senses.why: Latin securus means free from care, so the first sense is a state of being unworried because nothing threatens.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁 securus 意为无忧，因此第一义是「因无威胁而无忧」的状态。

senses.title: Measures and personnel
senses.definition: the guards, checks, cameras and procedures used to protect a place or people
senses.definitionCN: 用于保护场所或人员的保安、检查、摄像头与流程
senses.example: Security checked every bag before the concert began.
senses.exampleCN: 演出开始前安保检查了每个包。
senses.why: The abstract state is produced by concrete work, and the people who do that work are called by the same word.
senses.whyCN: 抽象状态由具体工作产生，做这项工作的人也被同一个词称呼。

senses.title: National security
senses.definition: the protection of a state's territory, people and institutions from external and internal threats
senses.definitionCN: 保护国家领土、人民与机构免受内外威胁
senses.example: The meeting discussed security along the border.
senses.exampleCN: 会议讨论了边境沿线的安全。
senses.why: The protected object grows from a person to a state, but the promise is the same absence of threat.
senses.whyCN: 被保护的对象从个人长到国家，但承诺仍是同样的「没有威胁」。

senses.title: Financial securities
senses.definition: financial instruments such as shares or bonds that represent value and can be traded
senses.definitionCN: 股票或债券等代表价值、可以交易的金融工具
senses.example: The broker sold the security before the market closed.
senses.exampleCN: 经纪人在市场收盘前卖出了那只证券。
senses.why: A tradable paper is a promise of value, and the old sense of a guarantee became a name for such instruments.
senses.whyCN: 可交易的票据是对价值的承诺，古老的「担保」义于是成了这类工具的名称。

senses.title: Collateral for a loan
senses.definition: property or assets pledged to a lender in case a borrower fails to repay
senses.definitionCN: 借款人为防违约而抵押给贷款人的财产或资产
senses.example: The bank lent against the building as security.
senses.exampleCN: 银行以那栋楼作抵押放贷。
senses.why: Here security is the thing that makes the promise credible, which is the legal branch of the word.
senses.whyCN: 这里的担保是使承诺可信的东西，这是这个词的法律分支。

senses.title: Certainty beyond doubt
senses.definition: a state of being certain or assured, an older sense now mostly literary
senses.definitionCN: 确定或有把握的状态，较古老、今多用于书面语
senses.example: He spoke with the security of a man who had checked every figure.
senses.exampleCN: 他说话带着一个核对过每个数字的人的笃定。
senses.why: Freedom from care can also mean freedom from doubt, and the word once carried that confidence.
senses.whyCN: 无忧也可以指无疑，这个词曾带有那份笃定。

senses.title: Computer security
senses.definition: the protection of systems, accounts and data from unauthorised access or damage
senses.definitionCN: 保护系统、账户与数据免受未经授权访问或损害
senses.example: The update closed a security hole in the browser.
senses.exampleCN: 这次更新补上了浏览器的一个安全漏洞。
senses.why: When the thing protected is a system, the old word is applied to a new object without changing its promise.
senses.whyCN: 当被保护的是系统，旧词被用在新对象上，承诺没有改变。

senses.title: Social security
senses.definition: a government system that provides income and support to people in need
senses.definitionCN: 政府为有需要者提供收入与支持的制度
senses.example: She paid into social security for thirty years.
senses.exampleCN: 她缴纳了三十年社会保障。
senses.why: A collective promise against hardship is a form of security, so the state's support takes the name.
senses.whyCN: 集体对抗困境的承诺也是一种保障，国家的支持因此取了这个名字。

senses.title: Emotional security
senses.definition: the feeling of being safe, accepted and stable in a relationship or setting
senses.definitionCN: 在关系或环境中感到安全、被接纳与稳定的感受
senses.example: The routine gave the child a quiet security.
senses.exampleCN: 这套日常安排给了孩子一种安静的安全感。
senses.why: The inner state is the oldest sense turned inward: no threat, therefore no worry.
senses.whyCN: 内在状态是最古老意思的向内转：没有威胁，因此没有忧虑。

senses.title: The professional field
senses.definition: the industry and profession of guarding people, places and information
senses.definitionCN: 保护人员、场所与信息的行业与职业
senses.example: He spent twenty years in security before teaching.
senses.exampleCN: 他教课之前在安保行业干了二十年。
senses.why: Once protection is a paid job, the word names the trade as well as the condition it produces.
senses.whyCN: 当保护成为有薪工作，这个词既命名行业，也命名它所生产的状态。

intro.en: Security comes from Latin securitas, from securus 'free from care', built on se- 'without' and cura 'care'. The financial and legal senses grew from the idea of a pledge that removes worry.
intro.cn: security 来自拉丁 securitas，上溯 securus「无忧」，由 se-「无」与 cura「忧虑」构成。金融与法律义从「消除忧虑的担保」这一想法发展而来。

items.en: Latin cura meant care, worry or attention, and it underlies cure, curious and accurate through related forms.
items.cn: 拉丁 cura 指忧虑、照料或注意，经相关形式衍生 cure、curious 与 accurate。

items.en: Securus meant free from care, built from se- 'without' and cura 'care', and it described a person rather than a place.
items.cn: securus 指无忧，由 se-「无」与 cura「忧虑」构成，最初描述人而非场所。

items.en: Latin securitas named freedom from danger or anxiety, and it could also mean a pledge that removed worry.
items.cn: 拉丁 securitas 指免于危险或焦虑，也可指消除忧虑的担保。

items.en: English security kept both the state of safety and the thing given as a guarantee, which is why the word covers guards and bonds alike.
items.cn: 英语 security 既保留安全状态，也保留作为担保之物，因此这个词兼指保安与债券。

items.en: From the seventeenth century securities named documents that represented a claim or a debt, and the plural became the standard financial term.
items.cn: 十七世纪起，securities 指代表索取权或债务的文书，复数形式后来成为标准金融术语。

items.en: Social security, computer security and emotional security applied the old promise to welfare, machines and feelings.
items.cn: 社会保障、计算机安全与情感安全感把古老的承诺用到福利、机器与情感上。

note.en: The first group looks or sounds like security; the second group names neighbouring ideas in the same field.
note.cn: 第一组在形音上与「security」相近；第二组是同一领域里意思相邻的其他说法。

entries.definition: The adjective and verb meaning safe or to make safe.
entries.definitionCN: 意为安全的或使安全的形容词与动词。

entries.definition: The adverb meaning safely or firmly.
entries.definitionCN: 意为安全地或牢固地。

entries.definition: The plural financial sense: tradable instruments such as shares and bonds.
entries.definitionCN: 金融复数义：股票与债券等可交易工具。

entries.definition: The lack of security, especially an emotional lack.
entries.definitionCN: 缺乏安全，尤指情感上的缺乏。

entries.definition: To turn debts into tradable securities.
entries.definitionCN: 把债务转成可交易证券。

entries.definition: Freedom from immediate physical harm, often more concrete than security.
entries.definitionCN: 免于直接的身体伤害，通常比 security 更具体。

entries.definition: The act of shielding someone or something from harm.
entries.definitionCN: 保护某人或某物免受伤害的行为。

entries.definition: A promise that something will be done or paid, close to the legal sense.
entries.definitionCN: 关于某事会被完成或支付的承诺，近法律义。

entries.definition: The state of being sure, close to the older sense of security.
entries.definitionCN: 确信的状态，近 security 的古老义。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real Latin care word, the real legal and financial branches and real fixed phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用真实拉丁「忧虑」词、真实法律与金融分支及真实固定搭配。

normal.en: Security comes from securus, free from care, built from se- 'without' and cura 'care'.
normal.cn: security 来自 securus「无忧」，由 se-「无」与 cura「忧虑」构成。

normal.en: The family runs secure, securely, securities, insecurity and securitize.
normal.cn: 同族词有 secure、securely、securities、insecurity 与 securitize。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the branches: national security, security check, social security, job security.
normal.cn: 固定说法标出各支：国家安全、安检、社会保障、工作保障。

normal.en: The plural securities is the standard financial term for shares and bonds.
normal.cn: 复数 securities 是股票与债券的标准金融术语。

normal.en: A pledge given to a lender is security in the legal sense.
normal.cn: 交给贷款人的抵押物就是法律意义上的担保。

abstract.en: Security is a promise that nothing will happen, made by someone who watches.
abstract.cn: 安全是一句「不会出事」的承诺，由某个守着的人作出。

abstract.en: The guard at the door and the bond in the vault are the same word.
abstract.cn: 门口的保安与保险柜里的债券，用的是同一个词。

abstract.en: What cannot be promised outside can sometimes be built inside, which is emotional security.
abstract.cn: 外面无法承诺的事，有时能在内心建成，这就是情感安全感。

examples.en: The airport raised its security after the incident.
examples.cn: 事件之后机场提高了安保级别。

examples.en: The fund bought a security backed by government bonds.
examples.cn: 该基金购买了一种由政府债券担保的证券。

examples.en: Job security mattered more to him than a higher salary.
examples.cn: 工作保障对他来说比更高薪水更重要。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「色求瑞提」——守着门、押着物，心里才不慌：安全、担保

root: 拉丁 securus「无忧」= se-（无）+ cura（忧虑）；名词 securitas 进入英语为 security。由「无忧的状态」发展出保护措施、担保、证券、社会保障与安全感等义。

sensesIntro.en: Ten senses follow one freedom from care: safety, guards and checks, national defence, tradable securities, collateral, certainty, computer protection, social welfare, emotional steadiness, and the profession that produces them.
sensesIntro.cn: 十个义项跟着同一个「无忧」：安全、保安与检查、国家防御、可交易证券、抵押品、确凿、计算机保护、社会福利、情感稳定，以及生产这些的职业。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: bags opened one by one at a concert gate while the line moves slowly past a metal detector.
core.cn: 核心意象：演出入口处，包袋被逐个打开检查，队伍缓慢经过金属探测门。

branches.en: THE INNER STATE: no threat outside, no worry inside, which is safety and then emotional steadiness.
branches.cn: 内在状态：外面没有威胁，里面没有忧虑，先是安全，后是情感稳定。

branches.en: THE WORK: guards, checks and cameras produce the state, and the people who do it are named by the same word.
branches.cn: 工作：保安、检查与摄像头生产这种状态，做这些的人也被同一个词称呼。

branches.en: THE STATE: the protected object grows from a person to a country.
branches.cn: 国家：被保护的对象从个人长到国家。

branches.en: THE PROMISE IN PAPER: a bond and a pledge are both guarantees that remove worry.
branches.cn: 纸上的承诺：债券与抵押物都是消除忧虑的担保。

branches.en: THE WIDER USES: certainty of speech, protection of systems and support against hardship all keep the old promise.
branches.cn: 更宽的用法：说话的笃定、系统的保护与对抗困境的支持，都保留着古老的承诺。

intro.en: Security is built on the Latin adjective securus, free from care, and the noun suffix that names a state.
intro.cn: security 建立在拉丁形容词 securus「无忧」与命名状态的名词后缀上。

latinIntro.en: Latin se- 'without' plus cura 'care' gives securus; securus plus -itas gives securitas; French carries it into English as security.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 se-「无」加 cura「忧虑」构成 securus；securus 加 -itas 构成 securitas；法语把它带进英语为 security。
